jobs.title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*
**Worker Type**
Regular
  
  
**Primary Location:**
Bangalore Technical Centre
  
  
**Additional Locations :**
**Job Posting Start Date**
2026-10-23

jobs.title: Assistanat Manager - Research And Development
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Hiring: Head Chef – Arabian Cuisine & Product Development (R&D)

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5+ years preferred

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and passionate
**Arabian Cuisine Chef**
, preferably with expertise in traditional Middle Eastern cooking and Arabic bread preparation, to join our team.

This is a specialised culinary development role focused on creating authentic recipes, developing new menu items, standardising food preparation processes and building comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for our restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Arabian cuisine, an understanding of traditional cooking techniques and the ability to translate culinary expertise into standardised, repeatable processes that can be implemented across multiple restaurant outlets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recipe Development & Menu Innovation**

* Develop authentic Arabian and Middle Eastern recipes.
* Create and refine recipes for Mandi, grilled meats, Alfaham, Shawarma, BBQ, kebabs, marinades, sauces, dips and other Arabian specialities.
* Experiment with ingredients, spices, cooking techniques and flavour profiles.
* Develop new menu items while maintaining authenticity and consistency.
* Conduct food trials, tasting sessions and product evaluations.

**2. Arabic Bread & Bakery Specialisation**

* Develop recipes and preparation methods for traditional Arabic breads.
* Expertise in Khubz, Pita, Saj, Khameer, Tannour and other Middle Eastern breads is highly desirable.
* Standardise dough preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking temperatures and cooking techniques.
* Establish consistent bread quality, texture, thickness and shelf life.

**3. SOP Development & Standardisation**

* Create detailed recipe documentation with exact ingredient quantities and preparation procedures.
* Develop step-by-step SOPs for food preparation, cooking, storage and handling.
* Establish standard portion sizes, cooking times, temperatures and plating specifications.
* Develop batch preparation methods for commercial kitchen operations.
* Ensure recipes are scalable and consistently reproducible across multiple outlets.

**4. Kitchen Training & Implementation**

* Train kitchen staff on newly developed recipes and preparation techniques.
* Demonstrate standardised cooking procedures.
* Establish quality control and consistency benchmarks.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs within kitchen operations.

**5. Food Costing & Quality Control**

* Assist in ingredient selection and sourcing.
* Develop recipes with commercial viability and cost efficiency in mind.
* Calculate recipe yields, portion costs and wastage.
* Maintain consistency in taste, presentation and product quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of professional culinary experience preferred.
* Strong specialisation in Arabian, Middle Eastern or Gulf cuisine.
* Previous experience working in Gulf countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman or Bahrain) is highly preferred.
* Strong expertise in traditional Arabic bread making is an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in recipe development and menu creation.
* Ability to document recipes and create structured kitchen SOPs.
* Experience training and managing kitchen teams.
* Good understanding of commercial kitchen operations, food costing and standardisation.

Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in chefs who understand the difference between simply preparing food and developing a consistent, commercially scalable food product.

The candidate should be passionate about authentic Arabian cuisine, detail-oriented, experimental and capable of building structured culinary systems from the ground up.

**Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on Gulf culinary experience and expertise in both Arabian cuisine and Arabic bread preparation.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume along with details of their culinary specialisation, previous experience and examples of recipes or menus they have developed.

* **We look forward to working with someone who can bring authentic Arabian flavours and professional culinary systems to our growing restaurant business.**

jobs.title: Team Lead – Protein Biology
jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)
  
  
**About The Company**
Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. (NYSE: TMO) is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $44 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics, or developing and manufacturing life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team delivers an outstanding combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience, and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon, and PPD. Our Innovative Laboratory technologies & Services makes it easier for customers.
  
  
About Team: Antibody team
  
  
The antibody team is involved in engineering and development of antibodies, with a deep focus on reagent quality and specificity. The core activities of the team include design, development, purification, conjugation and testing of antibodies in a variety of immunoassay applications using pioneering tools and technologies. The goal of the program is advanced product development and creation of product specific information to promote research use.
  
  
**Role:**
**To be an integral part of an antibody development team with a focus on performance and specificity using innovative molecular, protein, and cell biology methods. The successful candidate will be joining the Bangalore R&D leadership team for developing antibodies for the Thermo Fisher Scientific Antibody portfolio. This position involves people management, internal, external and cross function collaboration to drive technical strategies for execution in R&D projects involving state-of-art methods.**
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Perform in a fast- paced environment towards antigen and antibody development
* Lead team of scientists in matrix style operation, provide technical and operational supervision.
* Drive conceptualization within teams to enable development of successful protocols for antigen design and development
* Mentoring and training junior scientists in research, designing and experimental execution, interpreting data and data presentation to the stakeholders
* Partner with supporting functions such as product management, program management, operations, and business development to meet program goals.
* Good scientific writing skills, establishing technical protocols for effective transfer to operations teams.
* Good documentation practice is a must to maintain data integrity and accuracy.
* Delivering high quality results according to project schedule in support of product commercialization from concept to launch including early feasibility, development and validation phases.
* Support the manufacturing team for technical support and quality by providing technical guidance.

**Education & Experience needed:**
Applicants should have a Master’s degree with 15+ years R&D experience or PhD with 7+ years experience in a life sciences field with a strong focus on protein biology. Minimum 3-4 years of Industrial experience is required. Prior people management experience is essential.
  
  
Nature of experience:
  
  

* Strong domain expertise
* in the antibody development and engineering field including hybridoma, single B cell, and other recombinant antibody platforms
* Expert in the field of peptide and protein design, expression, purification, and protein-protein interaction (Structure -function -relationship)
* Thorough understanding of antigen/immunogen properties, design and development towards eliciting desired antibody response
* Extensive experience in expression and purification of recombinant proteins from bacterial, yeast, insect and mammalian systems
* Extensive experience in structural biology, antibody and protein engineering, computational modeling and rational design.
* Expertise in development of conjugation chemistries or performing antibody conjugations is desired
* Broad knowledge and experience in molecular biology, cell biology, immunoassays, protein design, engineering, purification, and conjugation fields to enable successful delivery on program goals
* Thorough in biochemical and immunoassay workflows such as ELISA, SDS-PAGE, Western blotting, IF, IHC
* Ability to provide technical trouble shooting to resolve scientific problems.
* Experience in authoring and optimizing standard operating procedures with a focus on reproducibility
* Skills for identifying deviations from expected outcomes, problem solving and suggesting alternatives
* Excellent written and verbal presentation skills
* Experience in leading product launches through knowledge and application of product commercialization processes including feasibility, development, and validation stages
* Proven leadership skills and ability to work alongside colleagues from different backgrounds
* Experience with leading and mentoring people with or without direct reporting structure
* Strong, independent understanding of standard and emerging research protocols and techniques are preferred

The successful candidate will be self-motivated and a self-starter who is excellent at learning and applying new concepts for process or product improvements, possess excellent people and project leadership skills including decision making and conflict resolution, oral and written communication skills to connect to peers and leadership, and demonstrate role model leadership for integrity, intensity, innovation, and involvement.
  
  
Thermo Fisher Scientific is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination basis race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, protected veteran status, age, genetics, pregnancy, disability or any other legally protected status. Thermo Fisher Scientific aligns with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
  
  
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. jobs.description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. At Dolby, we are changing the way the world experiences sight and sound. We enable people to experience music, movies, videos, games, and immersive content in their intended grandeur, making life and work more meaningful, expressive, and engaging. We provide technology to the world’s content creators, owners, and distributors, as well as manufacturers of TVs, mobile devices, PCs, and social and media platforms, so they can truly delight their customers. Dolby is behind many of the sound and imaging experiences people enjoy in movie theaters, living rooms, mobile devices, and online services around the world.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are building Foundational AI capabilities that advance how people create, understand, enhance, deliver, and experience media. This work spans foundation models, multimodal AI, generative media, content intelligence, media enhancement, personalization, and applied AI systems that can be reused and adapted across Dolby initiatives.

* Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of research scientists while building a culture that balances research creativity, responsible AI practices, and measurable product impact.

The Lead Develop Engineer will act as a technical leader passionate about developing, characterizing, qualifying, and applying material science with a focus in thermoplastic and elastomeric materials within the healthcare device sector. This position offers deep knowledge in polymer science, materials engineering, lab characterization, supplier qualification, and failure analysis. Key Responsibilities
  
  
Thermoplastic Resin Expertise
  
  

* Manage and drive material selection, development, and qualification activities for engineering thermoplastics and specialty polymers used in medical devices.

* Support molding process development, process validation, and scale-up activities in collaboration with manufacturing sites.
* Serve as a technical expert for polymer-related root cause investigations, product improvements, and build changes.

Elastomer and TPE Expertise
  
  

* Lead and drive the development and qualification of elastomeric materials such as TPEs, thermoset elastomers, stoppers, seals, plungers, and fluid-path components.

* Drive, lead and execute business critical sustaining programs through material changes by primary and secondary vendors.

Laboratory Testing & Characterization Expertise
  
  

* Build and complete material characterization strategies and capabilities in TCI-Bangalore to support product development, regulatory submissions, and manufacturing investigations.
* Apply, execute, and interpret advanced analytical techniques including Rheology, FTIR, FT-Raman, DSC, TGA, DMA, MFI, microscopy, surface metrology, mechanical testing, and thermal analysis.
* Develop test plans, interpret data, and generate technical conclusions to drive decision making.
* Lead root cause investigations involving material failures, particulate generation, deformation, discoloration, chemical incompatibility, or decline in performance.
* Establish scientific methodologies for predictive material performance modeling and structure-property relationship development.
* Collaborate with internal laboratories, external partners, suppliers, and academic institutions to solve complex technical challenges.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Polymer Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in polymer, polymer materials, lubricants, or other relevant material engineering fields for bachelor, 6+ years of experience in those fields for Master and 4+ years of experience in those fields for Ph.D.
* Deep expertise in thermoplastic resin selection, qualification, and processing.
* In-depth understanding of elastomeric materials, TPEs, sealing systems, and formulation development.
* Demonstrated experience with laboratory characterization techniques and advanced materials analysis.
* Experience leading technical projects and cross-functional teams.
* Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred**

* Medical device or pharmaceutical experience preferred but not required.
* Expertise in injection molding and polymer processing.
* Experience supporting regulatory submissions and medical device development.
* Experience with predictive modeling, structure-property relationships, and material simulation.
* Familiarity with supplier qualification, localization programs, and manufacturing transfers.
* Experience with sterilization effects on polymeric materials and long-term aging assessments.

Business Impact
  
  
This role advances BD's materials strategy by developing differentiated thermoplastic and elastomer technologies. jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist - Technical Service: Distilling and Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guiding purpose. It is how we have made an impact, and it is how we will continue to make a difference.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As an Industry Technology Specialist for Distilling & Biofuel, you will join our Technical Service team within Planetary Health Biosolutions.
  
  
Working closely with our Grain Processing team, you will provide technical support to customers in the grain-based ethanol and biofuel industries. You will design and execute plant trials, troubleshoot complex production challenges, and help customers optimize fermentation and ethanol production processes.
  
  
Through your technical expertise, analytical approach, and cross-functional collaboration, you will turn scientific and process insights into practical solutions that support customer success and business development.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide high-quality technical service to grain-based distilleries and ethanol-producing plants across India.
* Design, coordinate, and execute plant trials and experiments related to grain processing, fermentation, and ethanol production.
* Analyze trial and production data, draw clear conclusions, and communicate findings to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support customers in optimizing grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Recommend suitable yeast strains and support yeast propagation, viability, vitality, and performance management.
* Troubleshoot stuck or sluggish fermentations, contamination, low yeast viability, process deviations, and reduced ethanol yields.
* Optimize process parameters such as temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analyses using production data, trends, and relevant statistical methods.
* Support the improvement of sterilization and Clean-in-Place processes to help customers prevent and control contamination.
* Build strong working relationships with customers and collaborate with commercial, application, laboratory, and other cross-functional teams.
* Share technical knowledge and train customer teams to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* Between 5 and 10 years of relevant professional experience in a grain-based distillery, ethanol plant, or biofuel production environment.
* Practical knowledge of grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience working with grains such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat.
* Technical knowledge of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Experience selecting and managing yeast strains for ethanol production.
* Knowledge of yeast propagation and the management of yeast viability and vitality.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation issues, including contamination, low yeast viability, sluggish or stuck fermentation, and reduced ethanol yield.
* The ability to analyze production and trial data using Microsoft Excel or another relevant data-analysis tool.
* The ability to plan and lead plant trials and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India to support ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* A master’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* A strong understanding of yeast metabolism and its role in converting sugars into ethanol.
* Experience using statistical tools and data trends to investigate production deviations.
* Experience improving sterilization and Clean-in-Place protocols in an industrial production environment.
* A collaborative approach to solving technical challenges and sharing knowledge with customers and colleagues.
* The ability to work proactively, take responsibility, and translate new ideas into practical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative and scientifically driven environment where innovation, curiosity, and technical expertise are valued.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers, technical specialists, laboratory colleagues, and commercial teams while contributing to the advancement of biological solutions for the distilling and biofuel industries.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to apply your expertise to complex industrial challenges, develop new knowledge, and contribute to solutions that improve process performance and the use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

jobs.title: Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
**We’re hiring |**
Experienced
**Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer**

**Knoxx Foods Australia · Bengaluru (Bangalore)**

This role is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent travel to partner factories across India and willingness to travel overseas when required.

Knoxx Foods develops ingredients and meal components for Australian food manufacturers, including shelf-stable rice and pulses, dry blends and coatings. We’re looking for someone who has managed production at third-party food factories and can represent Knoxx on the factory floor. You’ll oversee how our products are made, how our formulations are protected and whether each order leaves the factory on time and in full.

**What you’ll do**

* **Manage production at partner factories.**
  Agree schedules for trials and commercial runs, confirm raw material and line availability, and track output and yields. When a run falls behind, agree a recovery plan with the factory and follow it through.
* **Verify product and process quality.**
  Conduct frequent site audits to assess facilities, testing capabilities and production practices. Observe live runs to verify that operators follow approved standard operating procedures (SOPs). Check batch records, traceability and test results against Knoxx specifications, then verify that corrective actions work.
* **Protect Knoxx’s intellectual property.**
  Before sharing formulations, process instructions or customer specifications, verify that each factory has confidentiality and access controls in place. During audits, check who can access the information, how printed and electronic copies are controlled, and whether obsolete versions have been withdrawn. Escalate suspected breaches and follow corrective actions through to closure.
* **Plan packaging ahead of every run.**
  Work backwards from the dispatch date to determine when approved pouches, labels and cartons must reach the factory. Confirm quantities, stock and supplier lead times, then track orders through receipt so shortages can be resolved before packing begins.
* **Optimise packaging.**
  Trial pouch sizes, carton configurations and pallet layouts with factories, suppliers and Knoxx R&D. Assess product protection, packing-line performance, waste, cost and container utilisation before recommending changes.
* **Ensure timely factory dispatch.**
  Confirm finished quantities, labels, packing lists, QA release status and freight collection against the committed date. Track each order until it leaves the facility and alert our Australian operations team early enough to act on any shipment risk.

**What you’ll bring**

At least 3 or more years hands-on experience managing production at third-party food manufacturers or co-packers is
**essential**
. You should also have practical experience auditing food factories, checking compliance with SOPs, handling confidential technical information, planning packaging and coordinating dispatch. A qualification in food technology, food science, food processing or a related discipline is a
**must**
.

**What you’ll get**

* Attractive Salary
* Company laptop and phone
* Reimbursement of interstate and overseas expenses.

**To apply**
, send me your CV by LinkedIn message with your current location, earliest firm joining date and
**confirmation that you’re available for domestic and overseas travel as described**
.

Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.

* Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
* Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
* Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
* Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
* Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
* Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
* Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
* Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.

The Global Solutions Risk and Compliance (GSRC) team ensures that Amazon transactions satisfy legal and safety requirements in accordance to the guidelines across global marketplaces. We proactively identify risks involved for Amazon while doing business in various countries and enable smooth flow of products across international borders. A Sr. Compliance Associate(DE) is responsible for protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, hazardous, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited /regulated by Law and Amazon policies.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Sr. Compliance Associate(DE), your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.

* Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)

Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Function:**
Legal at Diageo is about more than handling risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.
  
  
Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.
  
  
It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only authorities in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.
  
  
**About The Role**
Lead the operation and continuous improvement of Business Integrity’s Know Your Business Partner (KYBP) / Business Partner Integrity programme, helping ensure that integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners are identified, assessed, mitigated and monitored through a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach aligned to the Spirit of Integrity Framework.
  
  
The role will drive transformation and process improvement across the end-to-end KYBP lifecycle, working across Business Integrity and with Procurement, Commercial, D&T and other enterprise partners to simplify and strengthen processes, improve user experience, and make effective use of data, technology and automation. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, the role will also help find opportunities to align approaches, capabilities and ways of working across the function where relevant.
  
  
More broadly, the role will provide flexible project, analytical and operational capability across the Compliance Operations portfolio, supporting wider priorities and continuous improvement as the BI programme evolves.
  
  

* Lead the KYBP / Business Partner Integrity programme: Lead the operation and continuous improvement of the KYBP element of the Spirit of Integrity Framework, ensuring a clear, risk-based and proportionate approach to identifying, assessing, mitigating, approving and monitoring integrity risks associated with third parties and other business partners.
* Drive KYBP transformation and end-to-end process excellence: Lead transformation and improvement across the end-to-end KYBP / KYC / TPRM lifecycle, working across Procurement, Commercial, OpCoP, the TPRM Control Tower, Legal, Finance, D&T and markets to simplify processes, strengthen handoffs and accountabilities, improve user experience and embed scalable and sustainable ways of working. Work with Legal Operations and other partners where there are opportunities to demonstrate common approaches to process improvement, service delivery or transformation.
* Maintain KYBP standards, methodology and risk-based decision-making: Develop and maintain the standards, procedures, playbooks and methodology supporting KYBP, including risk segmentation, due diligence requirements, screening, red flags, issue, mitigation and ongoing monitoring. Work with relevant risk-domain SMEs to ensure appropriate coverage of bribery and corruption, sanctions, money laundering, failure to prevent fraud, facilitation of tax evasion and other relevant integrity risks.
* Strengthen data, technology, monitoring and programme effectiveness: Use data, insight and monitoring to understand the effectiveness of the KYBP programme and find opportunities for continuous improvement. Define business requirements and work with D&T, Compliance Operations and other partners to improve systems, workflows, automation and AI-enabled capabilities supporting business partner integrity. Support complex or non-standard business relationships and strategic transactions, including relevant joint venture and M&A due diligence, risk assessment, mitigation and integration requirements.
* Support delivery across the Legal and Compliance Operations portfolio: Provide flexible analytical, project and operational support across the wider Compliance Operations agenda, responding to evolving priorities and opportunities to strengthen the BI programme. This may include projects and initiatives across Speak Up and breach management, BI controls, policy governance, training and engagement, risk assessment and monitoring, data and analytics, regulatory developments, external benchmarking and other elements of the Spirit of Integrity Framework. Provide appropriate resilience and cover for key Compliance Operations activities as required. As part of the wider Legal and Compliance Operations team, give to cross-functional initiatives where relevant to the role's expertise and capabilities.

**Key Competencies**

* Business Partner Risk and Compliance Judgement: Strong understanding of third-party and business partner integrity risk, with the ability to apply risk-based and proportionate judgement across due diligence, screening, mitigation, issue and ongoing monitoring.
* Process Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement: Understands how processes, systems, data and controls connect, and identifies practical opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate and continuously improve end-to-end ways of working.
* Problem Solving, Delivery and Partner Management: Brings structure to complex, cross-functional problems, handles projects and priorities effectively, and works collaboratively across stakeholders to translate requirements and ideas into practical, sustainable outcomes

**Experience / Skills Required**

* Relevant experience in ethics and compliance, third-party risk management, KYC/KYBP, consulting, transformation or a related field.
* Experience in third-party or business partner compliance risk, including areas such as due diligence, bribery and corruption, sanctions, AML, fraud or other relevant integrity risks.
* Strong transformation, process improvement and project management capability, with experience delivering change across complex, cross-functional processes.
* Strong analytical and digital capability, with experience using data, technology, automation or workflow tools to improve processes and programme effectiveness; consulting or professional services experience would be helpful.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  

* Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
* We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, give and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to improve, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to give an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you gain this information when you submit your application.*

Regular
  
  
**Primary Location:**
Bangalore Karle Town SEZ
  
  
**Additional Locations :**

2026-11-19

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
**This role is for one of our clients**
Seniority level: Mid-Senior Level
  
  
Min Experience: 15+ years
  
  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
  
JobType: full-time
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Regulatory Affairs Manager to lead regulatory submission activities, ensure product compliance, and oversee regulatory lifecycle management across assigned markets. The role involves managing regulatory dossiers, coordinating with regulatory authorities, monitoring changes in global regulatory requirements, and ensuring timely approvals and renewals.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in regulatory compliance and dossier preparation, along with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and lead regulatory affairs professionals. This role requires a proactive approach to regulatory strategy, documentation management, audit readiness, and continuous compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Regulatory Submission Management
* Plan, review, and approve regulatory dossiers for new product registrations, renewals, variations, and amendments
* Ensure timely preparation and submission of CTD/eCTD dossiers in accordance with country-specific regulatory requirements
* Coordinate the compilation and review of quality, non-clinical, and clinical documentation required for regulatory submissions
* Monitor submission schedules, application progress, and approval status across assigned markets
* Coordinate responses to regulatory authority queries and ensure accurate, timely submissions within prescribed deadlines
* Review regulatory documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance before submission
* Regulatory Compliance & Lifecycle Management
* Ensure all registered products maintain valid regulatory approvals, registrations, and licenses
* Oversee post-approval changes, variations, renewals, amendments, and annual regulatory reporting
* Track regulatory commitments and coordinate their timely completion with relevant departments
* Monitor changes in domestic and international regulatory requirements and assess their impact on existing products and business operations
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable local and international regulatory standards
* Develop and implement processes to maintain regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Work closely with Research & Development (R&D), Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), Production, Supply Chain, Packaging Development, and Business Development teams
* Support new product launches through effective regulatory planning, documentation, and execution
* Provide regulatory guidance during product development, manufacturing changes, and technology transfer projects
* Coordinate the preparation, review, and validation of technical documents required for regulatory filings
* Ensure alignment between regulatory requirements and internal product development and manufacturing activities
* Regulatory Intelligence & Strategy
* Monitor regulatory updates and notifications issued by domestic and international regulatory authorities
* Analyse emerging regulatory trends and communicate their potential impact to relevant stakeholders
* Develop regulatory strategies to support product registrations, new market entry, and business expansion
* Evaluate regulatory risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures
* Identify opportunities to improve regulatory processes based on evolving industry standards and regulatory developments
* Team Leadership & Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop Regulatory Affairs Executives, Officers, and other departmental team members
* Allocate responsibilities, establish priorities, and monitor individual and team performance
* Conduct technical training on regulatory requirements, dossier preparation, submission processes, and compliance practices
* Establish and maintain departmental Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, and best practices
* Drive team productivity, accountability, and continuous professional development
* Audit & Inspection Support
* Coordinate regulatory documentation and provide support during regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Ensure the timely availability of required regulatory records, submissions, and correspondence
* Track and facilitate the closure of regulatory observations, audit findings, and compliance commitments
* Maintain audit readiness across all regulatory documentation and records
* Documentation & Record Management
* Maintain accurate regulatory databases, submission trackers, approval records, and compliance documentation
* Review regulatory correspondence and submission documents before dispatch
* Ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity of regulatory information
* Establish effective documentation, archival, and retrieval processes for regulatory records

Authority & Accountability
  
  
Authority
  
  
  

* Review and approve regulatory dossiers and documentation before submission
* Coordinate directly with regulatory authorities and authorised regulatory agents
* Recommend regulatory strategies for product registrations and market approvals
* Assign departmental responsibilities and monitor execution
* Approve regulatory documentation prepared by team members
* Identify and escalate critical regulatory risks and compliance issues to senior management

Accountability
  
  
  

* Ensure timely submission and approval of regulatory applications
* Maintain regulatory compliance across all registered products and assigned markets
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality of regulatory dossiers
* Facilitate timely resolution of regulatory authority queries
* Drive team productivity and overall departmental performance
* Maintain accurate regulatory databases, records, and documentation

Must-Have Skills
  
  
  

* Regulatory Compliance
* Regulatory Dossier Preparation
* Regulatory Submission Management
* Regulatory Documentation
* Regulatory Lifecycle Management

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  
  

* Regulatory Affairs
* CTD/eCTD Submissions
* Regulatory Intelligence
* Audit and Inspection Management
* Team Leadership and Development

jobs.title: Legal and Secretarial Associate
jobs.description:
**About Kapiva**

At Kapiva, we're on a mission to bring the wisdom of Ayurveda into the everyday lives of modern consumers. We combine time-tested Indian wellness traditions with scientific innovation to create nutrition-led health solutions that are natural, effective, and convenient.

Our portfolio spans multiple wellness categories including digestion, weight management, diabetes, cholesterol, skin & hair, immunity, and more. Kapiva has built a strong presence across leading e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa and BigBasket, while rapidly expanding its offline footprint through leading retail partners including Reliance Retail, Nature's Basket and Noble Plus.

Backed by leading consumer-focused investors including OrbiMed, Fireside Ventures, Vertex Ventures, 3one4 Capital, Sharp Ventures and Jetty Ventures, Kapiva is entering an exciting phase of scale. As we continue to grow, we are building people practices that are as innovative, agile and consumer-centric as the business itself.

**About the Role:**

This role demands a candidate with a strong foundation in legal principles, excellent drafting and negotiation skills, and the ability to assist in managing contracts, litigation, regulatory compliance, and intellectual property matters effectively in a dynamic business environment.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and review a variety of commercial contracts, including NDAs, manufacturing agreements, vendor agreements, service agreements, and other business-related documents.
* Assist in drafting and reviewing responses to legal notices, plaints, written statements and support dispute resolution processes. Coordinate with external counsels on litigation matters and ensure timely updates and follow-ups and maintain the litigation tracker.
* Support the filing and management of trademarks, copyrights, and patents to ensure all intellectual property of the company are safeguarded.
* Provide legal support on new product launches, collaborations, and campaigns, ensuring compliance with applicable laws (FSSAI, AYUSH, ASCI, Consumer Protection, etc.).
* Maintain organized and updated records of executed contracts, legal opinions, and other relevant documents.
* Assist in researching and reviewing new legal and regulatory developments to ensure compliance.
* Liaise with authorities for compliance queries, show-cause responses, and regulatory submissions.
* Lead periodic training sessions for internal teams on compliance and contractual awareness.
* Manage end-to-end company secretarial compliance under the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable Secretarial Standards, including convening and minuting Board, Committee and General Meetings, maintaining statutory registers, and ensuring timely ROC/MCA filings.
* Support fundraising and other capital transactions (private placements, preferential allotments, rights/bonus issues, ESOP grants and share transfers), including term sheet and SHA/SSA review, investor due diligence, closing documentation, allotments, cap table maintenance and FEMA/RBI reporting (FC-GPR, FC-TRS).
* Track and operationalise investor rights under the Shareholders’ Agreement and Articles of Association, including reserved matter/affirmative vote approvals and investor information rights.

**Basic Qualifications and required skill-set**

* Graduate in law with a legal experience of 4-5 years working in a law firm or in a corporate legal department as an in-house counsel preferably in the FMCG industry.
* Qualified Company Secretary (Associate/Fellow member of ICSI) with hands-on company secretarial experience in both a startup/VC-funded company and a listed company.
* Demonstrated active participation in fundraising rounds, from term sheet through closing, including due diligence, transaction documents, allotment and post-closing regulatory filings.
* Willingness to stay updated on evolving legal and regulatory landscapes and apply learnings in the organization.
* Partner with business, marketing, and operations teams to proactively identify legal risks and provide pragmatic solutions.
* A team player who can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across teams.

jobs.title: Field Application Specialist
jobs.description:
Cellink, part of BICO Group, is dedicated to Creating the Future of Health by leveraging the power of 3D cell culture through award-winning 3D bioprinters and carefully sourced biomaterials and bioinks. BICO is a lab automation partner and provider of selected workflows to pharma and biotech, with 46,000+ instruments installed in over 65 countries. BICO products, software, and solutions are found in more than 3,500 laboratories, including the world's top 20 pharmaceutical companies, and have been cited in over 12,000 publications. Operating through two business areas: Lab Automation and Life Science Solutions - BICO strives toward enabling and automating the life science lab of the future. BICO is listed on Mid-Cap, Nasdaq Stockholm under BICO.

They are looking for a
**Field Application Specialist**
who is pivotal in providing technical and application support during both the pre- and post-sales process. You will provide technical support and expertise to customers regarding the application and use of Cellink's products in the field, collaborating with clients to ensure effective implementation, training, and ongoing support, ultimately driving customer satisfaction and product utilization.

This is a full-time position.
**Employment will be managed through WorkMotion**
, acting as the direct employer to handle your local contract, payroll, and benefits. This role is based in Bangalore, with an expectation of traveling up to 75% of the time to customer sites for training, troubleshooting, and relationship management.

**Key responsibilities**

* Technical Support: Provide on-site and remote technical assistance to customers, addressing product-related questions and troubleshooting issues.
* Training and Education: Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers to enhance their understanding of product features and applications.
* Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within customer organizations to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, helping customers with scientific questions to achieve their research objectives and experiments in a contract research setting.
* Product Demonstrations: Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations to prospective and existing customers, showcasing the capabilities and advantages of the solutions.
* Feedback Collection: Gather and document customer feedback on product performance and application, relaying insights to the product development team for improvements.
* Market and Product Knowledge: Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, industry trends, and competitive landscape to effectively address customer inquiries.
* Reporting: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, training sessions, and support activities in the CRM system, and prepare reports on customer feedback and product usage.

**Candidate requirements**

* Education: At least a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Master's degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Technical Background: Strong background in cell-based assays, particularly 3D cell culture assay.
* Scientific Knowledge: Understanding of cell biology, 3D modelling, biomaterials, tissue engineering and regeneration.
* Lab Experience: Lab experience in cell culture, microscopy, and biochemical assays.
* Experience: 3+ years of experience in a technical support or application specialist role, preferably within a scientific, medical, or engineering environment.
* Communication Skills: Excellent technical writing and public speaking skills.
* Customer-Facing Experience: Prior customer-facing experience preferred.
* Languages: Professional-level English is mandatory.

**Desirable (but not required)**

* Experience with 3D printing preferred.

**Benefits and perks**

* Compensation: INR 1,200,000-1,700,000 a year (gross)
* Private Health Insurance

**About ADM:**

We are one of the world’s largest nutrition companies and a global leader in human and animal nutrition. We unlock the power of nature to provide nourishing quality of life by transforming crops into ingredients and solutions for foods, beverages, supplements, livestock, aquaculture, and pets.

**About ADM India Hub:**

At ADM, we have long recognized the strength and potential of India’s talent pool, which is why we have maintained a presence in the country for more than 25 years. Building on this foundation, we have now established ADM India Hub, our first GCC in India.

At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.

**Classification: Internal**

**Role Overview:**

**ADM is seeking a senior leader to establish and scale its Data, Analytics & AI organization**
within the Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru, India.
**This role is accountable for building a high-performing global delivery organization, advancing ADM’s enterprise data strategy, and enabling the scaling of digital and AI-driven solutions**
across the business. The Director will serve as a critical bridge between global and regional teams, ensuring the GCC

**operates as both a delivery engine and a center of excellence for data, analytics, and AI**
enablement.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**GCC Build & Organizational Leadership:**

* Establish and scale the Data, Analytics & AI function within the GCC, aligned to ADM’s global strategy
* Define the operating model, governance structure, and Ways of Working (WoW)
* Build and lead a high-performing team across data engineering, analytics, and AI enablement
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

**Data & Analytics Delivery Excellence:**

* Provide leadership oversight for end-to-end delivery across:
* Data platforms (Azure, Databricks, SAP Datasphere
* Master Data Management (MDM), data quality, and governance
* Business intelligence and reporting (Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, Tableau)

**Ensure delivery outcomes meet expectations for quality, timeliness, and business value:**

* Standardize tools, processes, and best practices across global teams

**AI & Digital Enablement:**

* **Partner with Digital & Innovation (D&I) teams to scale AI and digital solutions across the**
  enterprise
* **Enable transition of solutions from ideation and prototyping to enterprise-scale deployment.**

**Classification: Internal**

* Ensure data readiness, governance, and platform capabilities to support AI initiatives
* Promote adoption of emerging technologies aligned with business priorities
* Own the delivery of data pipelines, feature stores, and model-serving infrastructure that underpin AI/ML workloads
* Define clear boundaries between what the GCC AI team builds vs. supports, in coordination with the central D&I team

**Portfolio & Value Management:**

**Translate enterprise strategy into a prioritized data, analytics, and AI roadmap:**

* Establish demand intake, prioritization, and governance frameworks

**Track business value through KPIs, ROI, and benefits realization:**

* Optimize resource allocation and ensure alignment with enterprise priorities

**Stakeholder Engagement & Global Alignment:**

* Act as the primary interface between GCC and global leadership
* Collaborate with Delivery Directors and business stakeholders to align on priorities and capacity
* Communicate progress on delivery, talent, and innovation initiatives
* Build strong partnerships across business functions including Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and Master Data

**Talent Strategy & Culture:**

* Lead hiring, onboarding, and development of top-tier talent
* Establish structured career paths, mentorship programs, and capability development initiatives
* Embed ADM’s culture and values within the GCC
* Drive engagement, performance management, and retention

**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Leadership & Functional Expertise:**

**Classification: Internal:**

* 15+ years of experience in technology, with strong focus on Data & Analytics
* 8+ years in leadership roles building and managing global teams
* Proven experience in establishing or scaling global capability centers or delivery organizations
* Strong business acumen with ability to align technology initiatives to enterprise strategy

**Technical Expertise:**

**Required:**

* Deep understanding of modern data platforms and ecosystems (Azure, Databricks, or equivalent)
* BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent
* Master Data Management (MDM), data governance, quality, and migration
* Data engineering and analytics delivery at scale
* Solid experience in AI/ML product development, MLOps, or automation pipelines.

**Preferred (but not mandatory):**

* SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud experience
* Experience with digital product development or platform engineering

**Core Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking with a bias toward execution and measurable outcomes
* Stakeholder influence at senior executive levels

* Cross-cultural collaboration and communication across time zones
* Ability to navigate the politics of standing up a new function within a matrixed global organization
