jobs.title: Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales) – Food Supply Chain Traceability
jobs.description:
**Bengaluru · Hybrid · 2–5 years**

Help India's food and agri companies, from FMCG majors to seafood and meat exporters, trace every unit from farm and factory to shelf. As our first-line technical expert in sales, you'll turn the real-world complexity of factories and warehouses into traceability solutions that executives buy and operators actually use.

**About Tralexho**

Tralexho is a patented Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform for the food and agri supply chain, from raw material and processing to warehousing, distribution and the end consumer. Customers use us to cut losses and counterfeits, recall with precision, and comply from day one with GS1, HACCP, USFDA FSMA 204, EUDR and other standards.

We won the
**MoFPI National Award 2025 for Food Safety & Traceability**
, were shortlisted in
**APEDA's Business Challenge 2026 for export-enabling technology**
, and were named to
**Forbes India DGEMS Select 200**
. We co-authored the
**BIS traceability standard for India**
, are part of NVIDIA Inception, and run AI traceability research with ICAR-CIFT and KUFOS.
*Designed in India, designed for the world.*

**The role**

You'll join the revenue team, reporting to the Head of Sales, and own the technical side of every deal: discovery, demo, proof-of-concept and handover to implementation. You'll work with Indian enterprises serving the domestic market and with exporters selling into the US, EU and beyond.

**What you'll do**

* Run technical discovery with plant heads, quality and supply-chain leaders, and IT, and map the customer's current flows of material, data and systems
* Deliver demos tailored to the customer's own products, lines and warehouses
* Design and run PoCs with product and engineering: scope them, set success criteria, deploy and present the results
* Specify and configure sensors and scanners (barcode/QR, RFID, environmental sensors) for PoCs and deployments, and work with hardware partners on the shop floor
* Answer integration, data and security questions (ERP/WMS, APIs, device connectivity) and compliance questions (FSMA 204, EUDR, GS1, HACCP)
* Write solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners
* Bring field insight back to product so it shapes what we build next

**Your first 90 days**

* **30 days:**
  Know the platform and our standard hardware set well enough to demo it end to end, and shadow live customer engagements
* **60 days:**
  Run discovery and demos on your own
* **90 days:**
  Lead a PoC, including on-site device setup, from scoping to customer sign-off

**Must-haves**

* 2–5 years (career breaks included) in B2B SaaS pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting
* A solid grasp of SaaS architecture, APIs and data integration
* Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical buyers, and clear writing for proposals and RFPs

**Nice-to-haves**

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist - Aggregate Reporting
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities:**
The Pharmacovigilance Medical Safety Scientist is responsible for developing, reviewing, and maintaining high-quality safety and pharmacovigilance documents that support the safety surveillance and regulatory compliance of consumer health products.
  
  
This role requires the ability to synthesize data from multiple sources, including individual case safety reports (ICSRs), aggregate safety data, clinical studies, epidemiological research, literature reviews, post-marketing surveillance, signal detection activities, and other safety data sources. The successful candidate will transform complex safety information into clear, concise, and scientifically accurate documents that support global pharmacovigilance activities and regulatory submissions.
  
  
The individual will work closely with Drug Safety, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, Quality, and R&D teams to ensure consistent, evidence-based communication of product safety information.
  
  
**This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.**
**Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**
**Pharmacovigilance and Medical Writing:**

* Prepare, review, and maintain pharmacovigilance and risk management documents for consumer health products.
* Synthesize safety information from multiple sources, including:
* Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs)
* Aggregate safety data analyses
* Clinical trial safety data
* Post-marketing surveillance data
* Epidemiology studies
* Published literature
* Signal detection and evaluation activities
* Benefit-risk assessments
* Health Authority Assessment Reports

**Draft and support the preparation of:**

* Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs/PBRERs/PADERs)
* Ad Hoc Safety Reports
* Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs)
* Signal assessment reports
* Aggregate safety reports
* Risk management documentation
* Health authority responses
* Safety narratives
* Safety sections of regulatory submissions
* Safety surveillance reports and presentations
* Analysis and evaluation for the Safety Management Teams (SMT)

**Safety Data Analysis and Interpretation**

* Collaborate with Safety Scientists, Medical Reviewers and others to evaluate emerging safety information and communicate findings effectively.
* Assist in the interpretation of safety trends, potential signals, and benefit-risk considerations.
* Support literature surveillance activities and summarize relevant safety findings.
* Contribute to the development of safety conclusions and evidence-based recommendations.
* Support the preparation, review, and analysis of risk management activities and reports.

**Quality and Compliance**

* Ensure all documents comply with global pharmacovigilance regulations, company SOPs, and applicable guidance documents.
* Maintain high standards of scientific accuracy, consistency, grammar, and document quality.
* Perform quality control reviews of safety documents and ensure timely delivery of assigned projects.
* Support inspection and audit readiness activities through accurate documentation practices.

**Education/Experience:**

* Advanced degree required: PharmD, PhD, MD, MPH, MS, or equivalent scientific discipline.
* 8-10 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, medical writing, regulatory writing, or related pharmaceutical, consumer health, or medical device industries.
* Experience preparing safety and pharmacovigilance documents preferred.
* Familiarity with global pharmacovigilance regulations and safety reporting requirements.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment with multiple stakeholders.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong understanding of:
* Clinical research methodologies
* Epidemiology and biostatistics
* Evidence-based medicine
* Regulatory and scientific communication requirements
* Safety and benefit-risk assessment principles
* Expertise in literature evaluation and scientific data interpretation.
* Ability to critically analyze multiple complex scientific information and identify key insights to drive product safety.

**Skills:**

* Excellent medical writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Exceptional grammar, attention to detail, and document quality standards.
* Strong analytical and critical thinking capabilities.
* Effective project management and organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

jobs.title: Senior Associate-Data Privacy Assurance
jobs.description:
**About the role**
As part of the Group Privacy Team and as a Data Privacy Assurance Executive, I support the business to assess its data privacycompliance position by testing, validating and reporting on a range of data privacy controls
  
**You will be responsible for**
Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:Test (across the group) a range of data privacy controls. These controls have been established to ensure our business is operating incompliance with privacy laws (mainly GDPR). It is vital therefore Tesco's senior management understands whether the controls are inplace and effective, or not.- Regularly test and report on our 3 pillars of controls: Blueprint Controls, Operational Controls and Data Standards.-As part of my role, I am accountable for validating and challenging testing evidence submitted by stakeholders. Escalating whereneeded.- Overseeing stakeholders and building their engagement with the privacy assurance process.- Working with stakeholders to develop and implement remediation plans where testing reveals ineffective controls.- Delivering privacy assurance "deep dives" - targeting specific business units or functional areas for more thorough review of theirprivacy practices.- Over time the assurance will expand from purely data privacy testing to other compliance areas.- Understands business needs and in depth understanding of Tesco processes- Builds on Tesco processes and knowledge by applying CI tools and techniques.- Responsible for completing tasks and transactions within agreed KPI's- Solves problems by analyzing solution alternatives
  
**You will need**
 Assurance/controls testing experience.- Some understanding of data privacy principles.- Experience building credible and trusting relationships- A good understanding of how Tesco Group operates.
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. jobs.title: Deputy General Manager - Corporate Governance
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced CS + CA professional to lead funding-related governance, corporate compliance, and financial regulatory matters for our real estate business in Karnataka.

The incumbent will play a critical role in ensuring robust governance across funding transactions, lender relationships, debt structuring, statutory compliance, listing compliance and corporate financial matters.

The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to real estate financing transaction, project funding, lender documentation, corporate governance, debt listing requirements and regulatory frameworks with the ability to work closely with senior management, financial institutions, investors, trustees and external advisors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Funding Governance & Debt Compliance**

* Oversee governance and compliance aspects of project funding, construction finance, term loans, working capital facilities, NCD’s and other debt arrangements and work closely with corporate strategy team.
* Ensure adherence to funding agreements, compliance of condition subsequent, lender covenants, security creation requirements, charge creation & modification if any and contractual obligations.
* Coordinate with Corporate strategy team on funding documentation, disbursement conditions, and ongoing compliance.
* Monitor debt-related regulatory requirements, covenant reporting, and repayment obligations.
* Support refinancing, debt restructuring, and funding-related due diligence.
* Establish governance frameworks for effective monitoring of borrowing arrangements and funding utilisation.
* Coordinate with legal, finance, treasury, and project teams to ensure compliance with funding conditions and documentation requirements.

**Corporate Governance & Secretarial Compliance**

* Manage Companies Act compliance, board meetings, committee meetings, statutory registers, and regulatory filings of allotted companies.
* Ensure timely ROC/MCA filings, including filings related to borrowings, charges, and corporate restructuring of allotted companies.
* Oversee board and shareholder approvals for funding transactions, guarantees, investments, and related-party transactions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI, FEMA, SEBI, BSE and other regulatory requirements based on the company's funding structures and transactions.
* Support corporate restructuring, subsidiary governance, and SPV-related compliance.
* Maintain strong corporate governance standards across group entities.

**Financial Controls, Risk & Compliance**

* Establish and monitor internal controls relating to fund utilisation, loan compliance, and financial governance.
* Ensure alignment between financing terms, project cash flows, and regulatory obligations.
* Identify funding-related compliance risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Coordinate statutory audits, lender audits, internal audits, and transaction-specific reviews.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, reporting, and audit trails for major financing transactions.
* Identify and comply related party transactions

**Stakeholder Management & Management Reporting**

* Work closely with the Director – Corporate Affairs, Legal Head, and senior management on funding governance matters.
* Liaise with banks, financial institutions, legal advisors, auditors, trustees, and regulatory authorities wherever required.
* Prepare governance reports covering borrowing positions, covenant compliance, security documentation, and regulatory obligations.
* Provide governance inputs on new funding proposals, financing structures, and strategic investment transactions

**Desired Candidate Profile**

**Educational Qualifications**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS) and Chartered Accountant (CA).
* Additional qualifications in real estate laws, structuring, corporate finance, treasury, or financial risk management would be advantageous.

**Experience & Functional Expertise**

* 10–15 years of relevant experience, preferably in real estate or infrastructure development companies.
* Strong exposure to project finance, construction finance, structured funding, and debt governance.
* Hands-on experience in lender documentation, debt covenant monitoring, security creation, and charge registration.
* Deep understanding of Corporate Laws requirements and applicable financing-related regulations.
* Experience managing governance requirements for multiple SPVs and group entities and handling audit related queries.
* Ability to work effectively with CXO-level stakeholders, lenders, auditors, and legal advisors.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
jobs.description:
**Description**
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.
  
  
Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
* Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
* Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
* Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
* Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
  
  
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.
  
  
Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.
  
  
**About The Team**
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.
  
  
This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience within financial services and payment institutions
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
* Master's degree or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI HYD 13 SEZ - H84

**Role Summary:**

The Assistant Registrar – Legal & Compliance will support the Registrar and University leadership in managing legal, regulatory, statutory and governance-related matters of the University. The role will be responsible for monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, University statutes, ordinances and regulatory requirements; supporting the drafting and review of legal and institutional documents; coordinating with external legal counsel and regulatory authorities; and ensuring proper documentation and timely follow-up on legal and compliance matters.

The position will also support the University's statutory bodies, policy development, risk mitigation, and legal aspects of matters relating to students, faculty, staff, contracts, institutional assets and other administrative functions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Legal Affairs & Advisory:**

* Provide legal support and assistance to the Registrar and University leadership on institutional, academic, employment, contractual and administrative matters.
* Draft, review and vet agreements, MoUs, contracts, service agreements, NDAs, undertakings, notices and other legal documents.
* Review legal implications of proposed institutional initiatives, partnerships, contracts and administrative decisions and provide appropriate inputs.
* Coordinate responses to legal notices, claims, disputes and litigation in consultation with the Registrar and external legal counsel.
* Maintain an organised repository of legal documents, agreements, notices, case records and related correspondence.
* Maintain a comprehensive register of agreements/MoUs and monitor their validity, renewal and key contractual obligations.

**Regulatory & Statutory Compliance:**

* Monitor compliance with the applicable University Act, Statutes, Ordinances, UGC Regulations, AICTE requirements, State higher education laws and other applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.
* Track changes in education, employment, labour, data protection and other relevant laws and communicate their implications to concerned stakeholders.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of statutory returns, reports, declarations and other regulatory filings within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and follow up with concerned departments/schools for timely fulfilment of statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support the University during regulatory inspections, audits, accreditation processes and other statutory reviews from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Assist in identifying gaps in compliance and coordinate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

**University Governance :**

* Support the functioning of statutory and governance bodies of the University, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council and other committees, as assigned.
* Assist in preparing legal notes, background documents and compliance inputs for meetings of statutory bodies.
* Support the Registrar's Office in ensuring proper documentation, follow-up and implementation of decisions/resolutions of statutory bodies.
* Assist in reviewing University policies, rules, regulations and procedures to ensure consistency with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records relating to statutory approvals, resolutions, legal opinions and governance-related matters.

**Student, Faculty & Staff Related Legal Matters:**

* Provide legal and compliance support in matters relating to student discipline, grievances, academic integrity and other student-related issues.
* Support HR in matters relating to employment contracts, service rules, disciplinary proceedings and applicable labour/employment laws.
* Assist in reviewing service agreements, consultancy arrangements and other employment-related documentation.
* Support the handling of information disclosure, RTI-related matters, data privacy and other confidentiality-related requirements, as applicable.
* Ensure that appropriate legal and procedural safeguards are considered while dealing with sensitive institutional matters.

**Risk Management & Coordination:**

* Identify potential legal and regulatory risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Support the development and implementation of compliance mechanisms, checklists and standard operating procedures.
* Liaise with external lawyers, legal consultants, government departments, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal departments for resolution of legal and compliance issues and ensure timely closure of identified matters.
* Support internal audits, reviews and investigations relating to legal, regulatory and compliance matters.
* Maintain appropriate records and reports on the status of legal, regulatory and compliance matters.

**General Responsibilities:**

* Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive legal, institutional and personal information.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation and professional integrity in all legal and compliance-related work.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Registrar from time to time.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognised university/institution.
* LL.M. or an additional qualification in Corporate Law, Education Law, Compliance or a related area will be an advantage.
* Enrolment with the Bar Council is preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant post-qualification experience in legal, regulatory, compliance or university administration roles.
* Experience in a higher education institution, university, educational trust, statutory body or large organisation with significant regulatory exposure will be preferred.
* Experience in drafting and reviewing contracts, MoUs and other legal documents is essential.
* Experience in handling legal notices, disputes and coordination with external legal counsel is desirable.
* Experience in dealing with UGC, AICTE, State higher education authorities or other regulatory/statutory bodies will be an advantage.
* Experience in university governance, statutory bodies, policy development and regulatory compliance will be preferred.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong understanding of applicable education laws, University regulations, UGC/AICTE requirements, contract law and employment/labour laws.
* Working knowledge of data protection and privacy requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection framework.
* Excellent legal drafting, documentation, research and analytical skills.
* Ability to interpret legal and regulatory provisions and translate them into clear, practical guidance.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with senior leadership, faculty, administrative teams, external counsel and regulatory authorities.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines simultaneously.
* High level of integrity, discretion, confidentiality and professional ethics.

jobs.description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
This is a Consulting role for 3 - 6 months
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

jobs.title: Trading Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Full Stack Developer – Corporate Risk Reporting role focuses on the risk visualization layer of the Corporate Risk Reporting (CRR) platform. The role is responsible for building application capabilities that enable fast, flexible, and intuitive consumption of enterprise risk data for internal risk management users.
* Within the CRR architecture, core risk logic is implemented in PostgreSQL, with curated risk results published into OpenSearch to support high-performance reporting, fuzzy filtering, and interactive exploration. This role remains hands-on in building solutions using .NET-based backend services and React-based frontend applications, while also leading and coaching junior full stack developers to deliver cohesive, high-quality visualization capabilities.
* The position plays a key role in translating complex risk datasets into scalable and user-friendly reporting experiences, while setting technical direction and standards for the CRR visualization layer.

Key Accountabilities
  
  
**RISK VISUALIZATION DELIVERY:**
Designs and implements user-facing risk reporting capabilities that enable efficient visualization and exploration of enterprise risk data, including positions, P&L, FX exposures, and entering adjustments.
  
  
**FRONTEND EXPERIENCE DELIVERY:**
Development of high-performance and intuitive user interfaces using React and AgGrid, optimized for large datasets and advanced interaction patterns such as drilldowns, pivots, filtering, and navigation.
  
  
**BACKEND SERVICES AND APIs:**
Develops .NET-based backend services that mediate access to OpenSearch, support aggregation and query orchestration, and enable consistent data consumption patterns.
  
  
**OPENSEARCH CONSUMPTION:**
Implements effective OpenSearch query, indexing and consumption patterns to support fast retrieval, fuzzy filtering, and flexible exploration of risk data published from PostgreSQL.
  
  
**ENGINEERING QUALITY:**
Enforces engineering standards for the visualization layer, including code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD adoption, ensuring maintainable and reliable solutions.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE AND USABILITY:**
Owns performance and usability outcomes for the visualization layer, actively identifying and addressing bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and OpenSearch interactions.
  
  
**COLLABORATION:**
Works closely with the CRR Development Lead and Senior Business Analyst to align visualization capabilities with platform architecture and business risk requirements.
  
  
**CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT:**
Continuously evaluates and improves visualization patterns, technical approaches, and team practices to enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CRR risk reporting.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum requirement of 3 years of relevant work experience, typically reflecting 5+ years in delivering full-stack applications in data-intensive or analytics-driven environments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience delivery of user-facing reporting or analytics solutions, with proven ability to guide and mentor other engineers.
  
  
**Required Skills:**
**Mandatory:**

* Strong experience developing backend services using .NET
* Strong experience building frontend applications using React
* Hands-on experience with AgGrid for large, data-intensive reporting views
* Exposure to cloud-native deployment models and CI/CD pipelines

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with risk, finance, or trading reporting platforms
* Experience consuming and querying OpenSearch for fast, flexible reporting and fuzzy filtering
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL-backed data solutions
* Experience coaching or mentoring engineers in a delivery-focused environment

jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Product Engineer, Gaming

**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

**About:**

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
**data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership**
, and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for
**high-IQ, product-minded engineers**
who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end-to-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.

**The Role:**

You’ll be the person who
**collapses the gap between idea and evidence**
.

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
**hypotheses → prototypes → production systems**
.

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

**What You'll Do:**

* **Ideation & Concept Testing**
  : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
* **Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership**
  : Own prototype lifecycle end-to-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
* **Feature Development & System Ownership**
  : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems**
  : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation & Data**
  : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking**
  : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

**What You'll Bring:**

***Must-Haves:***

* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
  **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

**Why You'll Love It Here:**

* **Impact:**
  You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:**
  You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:**
  You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:**
  You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:**
  We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.

jobs.title: Product Development Engineer - Electrical (Wet Capacitor)
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
Hitachi Energy is looking for an R&D Engineer (Electrical) for the Wet Capacitors product line within the R&D organization of its High Voltage Products business unit in Doddballapur, Bengaluru, India. The role is responsible for the development and technical support of wet capacitor products manufactured worldwide and is part of Technology Center SAS within the global technology organization, which spreads across five locations worldwide. Hitachi Energy is a leader in high-voltage technology, offering products rated up to 1,200 kV that help enhance the safety, reliability and efficiency of power networks while minimizing environmental impact. Its technology leadership drives innovation in power transmission, enabling smart grids and enhancing eco-efficiency. The ideal candidate will enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment, be adaptable to business requirements and have experience working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask, meet deadlines and communicate effectively is essential.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Analysis through FEA tools – electrical simulation tools. Plan, perform and review calculation/simulations and qualification tests on various types of capacitors.
* Prepare / review design data in drawing, BOM, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, including DFMEA/DFM/DFA, perform prototyping & testing of capacitors. Prepare design documentation (Development report, analysis report, assembly & test instruction, test specification, etc.).
* Driving products change management process, leading project activities with a proven track-record of Project management.
* Participate constructively in working teams, share own technical/scientific knowledge in own projects and supports colleagues in applying processes and tools to ensure timely and high-quality results.
* Conduct quality case root cause analysis with solid engineering knowledge.
* Product harmonization, upgrades, and maintenance of capacitor products and solutions with high reliability and cost efficiency.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical engineering, preferably post-graduate / master’s degree.
* 4-6 years of experience in high voltage products design and development.
* Product knowledge of HV equipment / capacitors.
* Background and experience in the manufacturing industry.
* Ability to work in a global environment.
* Knowledge and understanding of various IEC / IEEE / ANSI / IS / ISO / DIN / IP / NEMA standards are preferred.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken), strong communication skills in a diverse and global organization.
* Innovative and creative thinking with strong problem-solving skills; knowledge of reliability engineering and life evaluation is an added advantage.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Overview**
The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. This role is responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. The Product Manager partners cross-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high-impact products that meet business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute 5-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence
* Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P&L to optimize margins
* Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns
* Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases
* Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle
* Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality
* Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction
* Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management
* Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools
* Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning
* Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement
* Partner cross-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption
* Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs

**KPIs**

* Revenue and profitability by product line
* Market share growth vs. competitors
* ROI on new product development
* Roadmap execution (on-time, in-scope delivery)
* Customer satisfaction and product adoption

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum five years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
* Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals.
* Advanced proficiency with product lifecycle management tools, data analysis platforms, and performance tracking systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills rooted in data-driven decision-making and customer-centric product development.
* A relentless pursuit of excellence and a strong desire to build innovative products that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation.
* Deep commitment to ownership, continuous learning, and taking proactive steps to improve product outcomes.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, marketing, or a related field.
* Advanced knowledge of product positioning, pricing strategies, and P&L management.
* Experience in developing business cases, ROI analysis, and product roadmaps.
* Deep understanding of Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, translating into product requirements.
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
  
  
**Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging**
At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

jobs.title: R&D Engineer - Copper Nanomaterials
jobs.description:
**About Anuna Labs**

Anuna Labs is a advanced materials deeptech startup developing high precision copper nanoparticles, conductive inks and advanced material technologies for next-generation industrial applications.

Our work focuses on scalable nanomaterial manufacturing and application development across sectors such as:

* Printed and flexible electronics
* Automotive Defogging & Heated Glass
* Solar Cell Metallization
* ElectroCatalysis & Hydrogen generation
* Energy Storage and Li-ion Battery Materials

**Who This Role Is For**

This role is intended for candidates who are genuinely excited about:

* nanoscience,
* experimental R&D,
* and building technology that matters.

This is not a conventional role where work is narrowly defined. You will work closely with the founding team and our clients, to understand the market feasibility and feedback, manage technical challenges, and gain exposure to how deep-tech products are developed from lab to application.

We are looking for people who:

* enjoy hands-on experimentation,
* are curious and self-driven,
* can work through ambiguity,
* and want meaningful ownership rather than a checklist internship experience.

**What you'll work on**

You will contribute to:

* Synthesis and optimization of copper nanoparticles
* Understanding & researching about nanomaterials market and applications
* Formulation and testing of nanoparticle-based applications such as: RFIDs, Solar Cell Metallization, EMI Shielding and more
* Experimental troubleshooting and process improvement
* Literature review and technical documentation
* Maintaining rigorous lab practices and safety protocols

**Eligibility**

Students or recent graduates from:

* Nanotechnology
* Materials Science
* Chemistry
* Chemical Engineering
* Metallurgy
* Materials-related disciplines

**What we We care more about:**

* curiosity,
* commitment,
* ownership mindset,
* and willingness to learn

than perfect grades or polished resumes.

Prior research or lab experience is valuable, but strong intent and consistency matter more.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on experience in nanoparticle synthesis or wet chemistry
* Familiarity with characterization techniques
* Ability to independently read and understand research papers
* Exposure to materials formulation or process engineering
* Strong experimental documentation habits

**Please apply only if:**

* You are available for full-time, on-site work in Peenya, Bengaluru
* You are comfortable spending significant time in a lab environment
* You are genuinely interested in nanomaterials and deep-tech startups
* You are looking to contribute meaningfully and grow with a fast-moving team

**Application Process**

Please mail the following to info@anunalabs.com:

1. Your resume
2. A short note (max 200 words) answering:

* Why are you interested in deep-tech startups?
* What excites you about nanomaterials and applied R&D?

Thoughtful applications will be prioritized over mass applications.

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position: Research Assistant**

**Summary**

The role of a Research Assistant is to support and contribute to ongoing research activities under the Mini Research Grant project titled
*“Degradation Study of Supercapacitor due to Ripple Current”*
at the School of Engineering, Chanakya University. The position involves assisting in experimental investigations, laboratory activities, data collection and analysis, and technical documentation to advance research on supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress, particularly in electric vehicle applications.

**Duration:**
6 months

**Responsibilities**

**Research and Experimental Activities:**

* Assist in conducting research activities related to supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress in electric vehicles.
* Support the development and execution of research plans, experimental procedures, and technical investigations.
* Conduct laboratory experiments involving supercapacitors, programmable power sources, electronic loads, and electrical measurement instruments.
* Assist in setting up, operating, and troubleshooting experimental hardware and laboratory equipment.
* Collect, process, analyse, and systematically document experimental data and observations.

**Technical Analysis and Documentation:**

* Conduct literature reviews on supercapacitor technology, degradation mechanisms, ripple current effects, and related power-electronic applications.
* Assist in analysing experimental results and interpreting the effects of electrical stress on supercapacitor performance and degradation.
* Prepare technical reports, research presentations, experimental records, and other project-related documentation.
* Contribute to the preparation of research papers and publications arising from the project.

**Laboratory Management and Support:**

* Assist in maintaining relevant laboratory equipment (power electronics and drives, and energy storage systems), experimental setups, and research-related records.
* Ensure proper handling and operation of electrical and electronic instruments during experimental investigations.
* Follow established laboratory safety procedures and maintain a systematic and organised research environment.

**Collaboration and Research Support:**

* Work collaboratively with the Principal Investigator, faculty members, and other internal and external research personnel to achieve the objectives of the project.
* Participate in research discussions, project reviews, and technical meetings as required.
* Contribute to other project-related research activities and responsibilities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

**Qualifications Required:**

**Essential Qualifications:**

* B.Tech./B.E. in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA, subject to university norms.
* Ability to conduct laboratory experiments and work comfortably with electrical and electronic hardware setups.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* M.Tech./M.E. specialization in Power Electronics, Electric Drives, Energy Storage Systems, or a related area.
* Hands-on experience with programmable electrical sources, power converters, power supplies, electronic loads, electrical measurement instruments, or data acquisition systems.
* Experience in MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, or equivalent computational tools.
* Previous research project experience or publications related to power electronics, energy storage, or electric vehicle systems.
* Ability to work independently in a research laboratory and systematically document experimental results.

**Experience Required**

* Fresh graduates may apply.
* Relevant laboratory, research, or project experience is desirable.

**Skills Required**

* Fundamentals of electrical engineering principles, power electronics, and energy storage technologies.
* Familiarity with electrical measurement instruments and hardware circuit development.
* Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent engineering simulation tools is desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Dedication to maintaining laboratory safety, and research integrity.

**Duration: Initial appointment for a period of six months, with the possibility of extension based on project requirements and performance.**

6–12 Years

Mumbai

Founder / Business Head

We are looking for a passionate and experienced New Product Development Lead to drive food innovation across our brands.

The role will be responsible for conceptualising, developing and commercialising differentiated food products across traditional Indian sweets, contemporary confectionery, chocolates, snacking and other food categories.

The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of food science, ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and consumer trends, combined with the creativity to develop exciting products and the execution capability to scale them commercially.

3. Process Development & Commercialisation

* Develop manufacturing processes, process parameters and standard operating procedures.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to establish production feasibility.
* Identify suitable equipment, technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Drive pilot batches, production trials and product validation.
* Ensure consistency and repeatability across production batches.

4. Quality, Shelf Life & Packaging

* Develop products with appropriate shelf life and stability.
* Work on preservation technologies, packaging compatibility and storage conditions.
* Conduct sensory evaluations, stability studies and shelf-life trials.
* Establish product specifications, quality benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with packaging teams to identify suitable packaging solutions.

5. Costing & Commercial Viability

* Develop product costing and optimise ingredient costs.
* Ensure formulations meet target gross margins without compromising product quality.
* Identify alternative ingredients and vendors.
* Evaluate scalability, manufacturing efficiency and commercial viability.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with marketing and brand teams to translate consumer insights into product propositions.
* Collaborate with procurement on ingredient sourcing and vendor development.
* Partner with manufacturing and quality teams for product commercialisation.
* Coordinate with packaging, sales and business teams to ensure successful launches.
* Build and maintain a structured product development calendar and innovation pipeline.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–12 years of experience in food product development, R&D or food innovation.
* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of food ingredients, formulations and processing technologies.
* Experience in developing and commercialising food products at scale.
* Knowledge of shelf-life enhancement, preservation systems and food packaging technologies.
* Understanding of food safety standards, FSSAI regulations and quality systems.
* Strong analytical, experimentation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance creativity, product quality, cost and commercial feasibility.

* Speed and efficiency of product development.
* Product quality, consistency and consumer acceptance.
* Shelf-life and product stability performance.
* Achievement of target product costs and gross margins.
* Successful scale-up from laboratory trials to commercial production.
* Innovation pipeline and launch calendar delivery.

A food innovator who combines the mind of a food scientist with the creativity of a product developer and the execution mindset of an FMCG professional.

Someone who is passionate about food, constantly curious about ingredients and technologies, and capable of converting exciting ideas into differentiated, scalable and commercially successful products.

jobs.title: Team Leader

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals (R&D)
jobs.description:
Job Description | Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Research & Development
  
  
**Role at a glance**
Mosaic Wellness is hiring an Assistant Manager to own gummy and nutraceutical development, from bench formulation to commercial launch.
  
  
**Position**
Assistant Manager – Gummies & Nutraceuticals
**Function**
Research & Development (New Product Development)
**Location**
Thane West, Mumbai
**Reports to**
Head of R&D
**Experience**
6–10 years in nutraceutical R&D, including hands-on gummy development
**Education**
M.Sc. (Science) or M.Tech in a relevant discipline
**Travel**
Regular visits to CDMO and supplier sites across India
**Employment**
Full-time
  
  
**About Mosaic Wellness**
Mosaic Wellness is a Mumbai-based, digital-first health and wellness company. Its consumer brands, including Man Matters, Be Bodywise and Little Joys, serve men’s, women’s and children’s health and nutrition needs.
  
  
Our R&D team develops science-led nutraceuticals, functional foods and personal care products with manufacturing partners across India. Gummies are a key format across the portfolio.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You will own gummy and nutraceutical products end to end: formulation on the bench, scale-up at CDMOs, and a stable, compliant commercial launch.
  
  
The role solves the hard problems of the gummy format: high active loads, taste masking, sugar reduction, texture and shelf-life stability. You will be R&D’s point person for this category across brands, working closely with Brand, Quality, Regulatory, Procurement and manufacturing partners.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Formulation and product development**

* Develop gummies across gelling systems (gelatin, pectin, carrageenan, agar, starch), including vegan, sugar-free and reduced-sugar variants.
* Formulate with demanding actives: vitamins, minerals, botanicals, probiotics, prebiotic fibres and other high-load ingredients.
* Engineer taste and texture through bitterness masking, flavour and acid profiling, chew optimisation, colour stability, sanding and oil coating.
* Design out gummy failure modes: sweating, stickiness, crystallisation, syneresis, heat deformation, browning and active degradation.
* Extend expertise to other formats as needed: powders and sachets, tablets, capsules, effervescents and chewables.

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  

* Run bench trials, Design of Experiments (DoE) and sensory evaluations, with complete lab records.

**Process development, scale-up and tech transfer**

* Define critical process parameters: cook temperature and solids (°Brix), deposit pH and temperature, deposit weight, curing conditions and final water activity.
* Lead pilot, scale-up and first commercial batches on starch mogul and starchless depositing lines at CDMO sites.
* Prepare tech-transfer packages: formula, bill of materials, process flow, Master Formula Record inputs and specifications.
* Troubleshoot weight variation, tailing, mould sticking and yield loss to deliver right-first-time commercialisation.

**Stability, quality and analytics**

* Design accelerated and real-time stability studies under ICH-aligned conditions (including Zone IVb, 30 °C/75% RH) to set overages and shelf life.
* Write raw material, packaging and finished-goods specifications; review analytical data with in-house teams and NABL-accredited labs.
* Select packaging for moisture and oxygen protection, backed by water-activity and moisture-sorption data.
* Lead root-cause analysis and CAPA for deviations, out-of-specification results and consumer complaints.

**Regulatory and documentation**

* Keep formulations and labels compliant with FSSAI’s Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations (2022), Labelling and Display Regulations (2020) and AYUSH norms where relevant.
* Check ingredient permissibility, RDA-based limits and label claims; prepare technical dossiers, including for Non-Specified Food approvals.
* Support export-market requirements (e.g., GCC, US 21 CFR) with Regulatory Affairs.

**Ingredients, partners and cost**

* Scout and qualify new ingredients, technologies and suppliers, and develop alternate sources for supply resilience.
* Assess CDMO capability and build strong technical partnerships with manufacturing and ingredient partners.
* Hit COGS targets through formulation and process value engineering, without compromising efficacy or sensory quality.

**Collaboration and team**

* Translate brand and consumer briefs into technical briefs, and deliver launches on the NPD calendar with cross-functional teams.
* Guide and mentor junior scientists, and share learnings across R&D.
* Track global gummy and delivery-format trends, and contribute to patents and scientific publications.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Education**
**One Of The Following**

* M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Chemical Engineering or Pharmaceutical Technology

Mosaic Wellness Pvt. Ltd. | Page of
  
  
**Experience**

* 6–10 years in R&D or NPD for nutraceuticals, health supplements or functional foods, at a consumer brand, nutraceutical company or CDMO.
* At least 3 years of hands-on gummy development, with products taken from concept to commercial launch.
* Scale-up experience on mogul or starchless depositing lines, in-house or at a CDMO.
* A track record of stability-led formulation, setting overages and shelf life for vitamins, botanicals or probiotics.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong grasp of hydrocolloid and sugar/polyol science: gelation, pH and calcium sensitivity, glass transition, crystallisation and water activity.
* Confident with analytical data: assay and HPLC results, moisture and water activity, texture analysis and microbiology.
* Working knowledge of FSSAI nutraceutical and labelling regulations, GMP and HACCP.
* Structured experimentation (DoE), clear technical documentation and crisp reporting.
* Able to run several projects, CDMOs and stakeholders in parallel.

**Good to have**

* Experience with tablets, capsules, softgels, powders or effervescents alongside gummies.
* Probiotic, high-fibre, high-load or centre-filled gummy development.
* Work with microencapsulated actives or other novel delivery formats.
* Exposure to export regulations: US 21 CFR 111, GCC (GSO) or EU.
* Experience in a D2C or fast-growing consumer health company.
* Patents or peer-reviewed publications.
* Statistical tools such as Minitab, JMP or Design-Expert.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**
Within a year, gummies are a dependable, scalable platform for Mosaic’s brands.
  
  

* Gummy and nutraceutical launches delivered on the NPD calendar, scaled up right first time at CDMOs.
* Every launched SKU meets label claim through shelf life, backed by robust stability data.
* Measurable COGS savings from value engineering on existing products.
* A stronger gummy platform: documented process windows, qualified alternate suppliers and fewer quality complaints.

**Why join**
You get real ownership, scientific depth and room to grow.
  
  

* Own a key format end to end, with direct influence on what reaches consumers.
* Work in a lean, decentralised R&D team where scientists own their projects and decisions sit close to the bench.
* Grow beyond gummies into nutraceuticals, functional foods and novel delivery technologies.
* Build your scientific profile through patents and publications, alongside leaders with deep global CPG experience.

jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.
