--------------------

**Position: Executive – NPD**
=============================

**New Product Development (Confectionery)**
===========================================

**Department:** Product and Technology Development (PTD)
  
**Category:** Confectionery
  
**Location:** NPD Laboratory, Greater Noida
  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

### **1. Job Purpose**

To support New Product Development activities in the confectionery category through hands-on laboratory work, prototype preparation, sample development, product evaluation and execution of R&D trials. The position will be primarily based in the NPD laboratory and responsible for ensuring timely preparation of quality prototypes, lab report preparation and samples as per project requirements.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Laboratory Prototype Development**

* Prepare laboratory-scale prototypes for various confectionery and its allied products as per project briefs and technical requirements.
* Execute product formulation, ingredient weighing, mixing, processing and sample preparation.
* Support the development of new product concepts, flavors, textures, shapes and variants.
* Work on product modifications and formulation adjustments based on feedback from internal stakeholders.
* Maintain consistency and reproducibility of laboratory prototypes.

**B. Sample Preparation & Management**

* Prepare product samples for internal evaluations, sensory assessments, consumer testing and customer presentations.
* Ensure proper labelling, coding, packaging and storage of prototype samples.
* Maintain sample records, formulation details and development history.
* Coordinate timely dispatch and availability of samples for different stakeholders.

**C. Laboratory Trials & Equipment Handling**

* Conduct laboratory trials using confectionery processing equipment and laboratory tools.
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment while following established operating procedures.
* Ensure proper cleaning, sanitation and maintenance of laboratory equipment and workstations.
* Support pilot-scale and factory trials whenever required.

**D. Documentation & Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records of formulations, raw material consumption, trial observations and process parameters.
* Prepare laboratory trial reports and maintain sample tracking records.
* Update formulation sheets, trial logs and product development databases.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all development activities.

**E. Raw Material & Inventory Management**

* Maintain laboratory raw material inventory and ensure availability of ingredients required for development activities.
* Monitor raw material consumption, expiry dates and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams for raw material requirements.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of food ingredients as per recommended conditions.

**F. Quality, Safety & Hygiene**

* Follow food safety, personal hygiene and laboratory safety practices.
* Ensure cleanliness and housekeeping of the NPD laboratory.
* Identify and report any deviations in raw material quality or laboratory processing.
* Follow established SOPs and maintain good laboratory practices.

**G. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with NPD team members for timely execution of development projects.
* Support Marketing, Quality, Production and other stakeholders in sample preparation and product evaluation.
* Incorporate feedback from sensory evaluations and internal product reviews into subsequent prototypes.

### **3. Key Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in food product development or confectionery laboratory operations.
* Basic understanding of confectionery ingredients, formulations and processing techniques.
* Practical knowledge of weighing, mixing, heating, forming, depositing and sample preparation.
* Good observation, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint).
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple sample development requirements and timelines.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

### **4. Educational Qualification**

* M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology or related disciplines.

### **5. Experience**

* **Preferred experience:** 2–5 years in Food R&D, New Product Development or laboratory operations.
* Experience in confectionery products such as gummies, jellies, hard-boiled candies, toffees, lollipops or similar categories will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and relevant academic exposure may also be considered.

### **6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely preparation and delivery of prototype samples.
* Accuracy and consistency of laboratory formulations.
* Successful execution of assigned laboratory trials.
* Accuracy and completeness of trial documentation.
* Effective management of laboratory raw materials and inventory.
* Compliance with laboratory hygiene, safety and housekeeping standards.
* Responsiveness to internal sample development requirements.

### **7. Nature of Role**

This is a hands-on, laboratory-oriented position requiring regular involvement in prototype preparation, product development experiments, sample handling and laboratory operations. The incumbent will be primarily stationed at the NPD laboratory and will support factory/pilot and factory trials as and when required.

New Product Development

Food Science

Food Technology

Lab handling

jobs.title: Manager Group Demand Planning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.

 **Job Description**

The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Your Responsibilities  
1. Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics  

* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.

2. Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation  

* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.

3. Data Preparation & Quality Management  

* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.

4. Business Partnership & Decision Support  

* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.

5. Strategic Planning & Modelling  

* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

 **Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning sys

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Compensation:** Consultant fee (fixed or monthly retainer or Project Based feedback ), to be discussed

jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure

**Self Care (OTC), Skin Health, Baby Care, and Oral Care**

+ Gas Chromatography (GC)

+ ICP-MS

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong foundation in analytical chemistry and pharmaceutical sciences.

* Hands-on expertise with modern analytical instrumentation and laboratory technologies.
* Understanding of stability study design and product shelf-life assessment.
* Working knowledge of cGMP, data integrity principles, and quality management systems.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations and audited environments.
* Proficiency in digital laboratory systems and scientific software applications.
* Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

**Leadership & Professional Competencies**

* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and a commitment to high-quality execution.
* Applies scientific curiosity and critical thinking to solve complex analytical challenges.
* Embraces innovation and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and capabilities.
* Communicates effectively with diverse stakeholders across functions, sites, and geographies.
* Builds collaborative partnerships and fosters a culture of teamwork and inclusion.
* Delivers results with agility while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**

* M.Sc., B.Pharm., M.Pharm., Ph.D., or equivalent qualification in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

**Professional Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in:

+ Analytical Development
+ Quality Control
+ Pharmaceutical or Consumer Health R&D
+ Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or FMCG industries

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to analytical method development and validation.
* Experience working within GMP-regulated laboratories.

* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and quality audits.

**Digital Skills**

jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

 **Qualifications**

A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

jobs.title: ISO 22000 Auditor
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
“At QIMA, you feel like you belong from Day 1. You join a community of smart minds who not only innovate, but also support and inspire each other. Here, we own our work, have fun together, and make everyday count.”
  
  
The QIMA and EFRAC Story
  
  
At QIMA, our Food Division is dedicated to helping every member of the global food supply chain ensure the safety and quality of food products, as well as safe working conditions and sustainable practices. With inspections, audits and certifications, we support food growers, producers and retailers, as well as businesses in food service and hospitality, securing their food products' journey from farm to shelf and fork.
  
  
Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
  
  
EFRAC, part of QIMA group is a laboratory testing services company focusing on food safety, pharmaceutical quality control, and environmental monitoring.
  
  
What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
  
  
**Job Description**
The Role in Brief
  
  
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ISO 22000 Auditor to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting audits of food safety management systems in accordance with ISO 22000 standards. This role requires a comprehensive understanding of food safety principles, risk management, and the ability to assess compliance effectively.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include**

* Perform comprehensive audits of food safety management systems (FSMS) in accordance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Assess documentation, including food safety policies, procedures, and records, to ensure compliance with ISO requirements.
* Analyze the effectiveness of the FSMS, including hazard analysis and critical control points (HACCP), to identify potential risks.
* Detect areas of non-compliance or weaknesses in the FSMS and provide recommendations for corrective actions.
* If applicable, oversee the collection of samples for testing to verify compliance with safety standards.
* Prepare detailed audit reports summarizing findings, observations, and recommendations for improvements.

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Develop and implement audit plans for ISO 22000 compliance.
* Conduct thorough audits of food safety management systems, assessing processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Prepare detailed audit reports that highlight findings, non-conformities, and areas for improvement.
* Maintain accurate and organized records of all audit activities and compliance assessments.
* Collaborate with food business operators and staff to enhance understanding of ISO 22000 standards.
* Provide recommendations and support for corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Stay informed about industry trends and changes in regulations to ensure compliance with ISO 22000 standards.
* Recommend enhancements to audit processes and tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Engage in ongoing professional education to remain current with ISO standards and food safety practices.
* Attend relevant workshops, training sessions, and industry conferences.

Profile Requirements
  
  
**To Succeed In This Role, You Have**

* A food-related or bioscience degree (minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent) OR Atleast a successfully completed food-related professional higher education.
* At least 2 years of work experience in food industry
* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* A minimum of two (2) year work experience, which may include consulting activities, in food safety and/or quality management within the food industry sector OR at least 5 (10 man-days) third-party or second-party audits that includes HACCP, QMS and Food Safety requirements.
* HACCP course (minimum 16 hours) recognized by the International HACCP Alliance; and ISO 22000:2018 course (minimum of 16 hours) + Lead Auditor course (on QMS) of 40 hours of duration including the exam. OR Lead Auditor Course (FSMS (ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000) of 40 hours of duration including the exam.
* Minimum: 20 days as auditor of Quality Management Systems, Food Safety Management Systems or other Food Safety Standards (i.e. GFSI).

If you possess the skills and experience required for this role and are passionate about driving business growth in the food industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as our Regional Sales Manager.

jobs.title: Lead Corporate Affairs
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
As a world market leader in crop protection, we help farmers to counter these threats and ensure enough safe, nutritious, affordable food for all – while minimizing the use of land and other agricultural inputs.
  
  
Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.
  
  
Syngenta Crop Protection is headquartered in Switzerland.
  
  
**Job Description**
**ROLE PURPOSE**
**To support the strategic direction and achievement of business objectives of Syngenta in India, enhancing freedom to operate through building and maintaining Syngenta’s reputation externally.**

* To support the strategic direction and achievement of Syngenta’s business objectives in India by enhancing its freedom to operate, strengthening external reputation, and driving effective corporate affairs, government relations and public policy engagement.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing the regional Corporate Affairs strategy, translating regional priorities into India-specific action plans and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
* Develop and implement an India Corporate Affairs action plan in consultation with the Head of Corporate Affairs to support business objectives, ensure consistent engagement with key stakeholders, and strengthen Syngenta’s reputation in India.
* Work with business leaders and commercial unit heads to implement local and regional programs, ensuring disciplined and consistent internal and external communications, systematic stakeholder mapping, and effective stakeholder engagement.'

**Accountabilities**
**Reputation Management, Governmental and Public Affairs**

* Develop a Corporate Affairs & Reputation Management action plan for India that supports the delivery of the regional corporate affairs strategy, and which is specific to the circumstances, issues and stakeholders in India. The approach should identify key stakeholders (government, research institutes, NGOs, media, investors, academics etc) and their influencers across the region and form the basis for detailed action and engagement plans.
* Support the Head of Corporate Affairs in developing and implementing regional Corporate Affairs strategies, priorities and programs, ensuring effective execution in India and alignment with regional objectives, business priorities and global reputation management frameworks.
* Support external communications and media relations in India in collaboration with appointed PR agencies, including communication planning, media engagement, press releases, media briefings and other external communication materials, ensuring consistency with Syngenta’s corporate positioning and messaging.
* Deliver pro-active reputation management (identification, informing, educating and influencing), particularly with key government stakeholders relevant issues (e.g. technology acceptance, public private partnerships and collaborations, regulatory policy and implementation in concert with regulatory affairs through a “License to Operate” environment) with disciplined and consistent stakeholder management activities including the use of direct engagement and the full array of communication and influence channels – media, public forums, industry groups, speeches and keynotes etc.
* Maintain regular dialogue on key issues with key government, industry and NGO contacts to ensure Syngenta’s position on key issues and our contribution to the management of these issues is well understood and accepted. Ensuring wherever possible the alignment between stakeholder objectives and Syngenta’s own objectives.

* Contributes to strengthening the organization’s technical knowledge of the regulatory and policy environment by effectively engaging with government ministries and regulatory authorities, while applying strong technical expertise to interpret and navigate registration requirements, processes, and compliance nuances.
* Responsible for securing and maintaining the License to Operate (LTO) and License to Produce (LPO) for the SIPL portfolio, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, regulatory compliance, and business continuity.
* Work with Regulatory Affairs managers to ensure a smooth transfer of existing government networks and contacts
* Provide inputs to the annual cycle of events associated with global reputation management, including inputs to the Annual Report, position papers, media releases and general events as they relate to South Asia
* Track Syngenta’s reputation across South Asia identifying key metrics and drivers and then establishing issues, themes and possible response strategies
* Ensure a consistent approach to reputation management through adoption of best practice common procedures and tools and sharing of best practices within business units

**Public Policy / Public Relations**

* Partners with non-government think tanks, state industry bodies, farmer networks, and NGOs to advance policy advocacy and reputation management objectives.

**Crisis Communications - EMS**

* Working with the Regional EMS Team, develop crisis communications plan as necessary to support corporate reputation in India

**Qualifications**
**Critical Knowledge & Experience:**

* 15+ years of experience in Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Public Policy, or Reputation Management within a multinational organization (agriculture, biotech, or allied sectors preferred).
* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture, Public Policy, Law, Business Administration, or a related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of the Indian agriculture sector, regulatory landscape, and public policy environment.
* Proven experience engaging with Central and State Government stakeholders, industry associations, and regulatory authorities.
* Strong knowledge of regulatory processes, registrations, License to Operate (LTO), and License to Produce (LPO) requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to build, influence, and maintain relationships with senior external stakeholders.
* Strong government stakeholder relationship management and influencing skills.
* Experience in reputation management, policy advocacy, and issues management.
* At least 5 years of experience working with cross-functional and cross-cultural teams in Asia.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with full command of English.

**Critical Skills**

* Strong understanding of regulatory and policy frameworks with the ability to navigate government processes and registration requirements
* Ability to work independently and build effective networks across stakeholders in India and within the organization.
* Strategic, analytical, creative and influencing skills.
* Leadership and team management skills, i.e. ability to build good relationships at all levels and to be able to advise, influence and coach.
* Proactive, self motivating, decisive, high level of crisis tolerance.
* Understanding complex change management and stakeholder engagement initiatives.
* Ability to communicate and interact within diverse environments (employees, influencers, customers, etc.).

**Other Behaviors, Critical For The Role**
Good team player. Interpersonal skills. Attention to detail; ability to find win-win solutions; ability to serve as a conduit in the flow of information between communications team and business units; flexibility in a fast-paced organization; ability to frequently measure the effectiveness of ongoing programs and adapt accordingly.

**People are at the heart of what we do:**

1. Job Purpose

To conduct regular quality audits across dairy plants, BMCs (Bulk Milk Cooling Centres), milk collection centres, and other operational locations to ensure compliance with quality standards, food safety regulations, hygiene practices, and company policies. The role involves extensive travelling, identifying quality gaps, preparing audit reports, and ensuring timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Quality & Process Auditing**

* Conduct scheduled and surprise quality audits at dairy plants, BMCs, milk collection centres, and other company locations.
* Monitor milk procurement, reception, processing, pasteurization, chilling, storage, and dispatch processes.

* Inspect raw milk, processed milk, and finished dairy products for quality compliance.
* Check hygiene, sanitation, cleaning procedures, and CIP (Cleaning-in-Place) practices.

**B. Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of dairy quality parameters and food safety standards.

Job Description: Quality Control (QC) Officer / Executive – Food Industry

**Job Title:** Quality Control (QC) Officer / Executive

**Department:** Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)

**Industry:** Food & Beverage Manufacturing / Processing

**Reports To:** Quality Manager / Plant Head

**Location:** KOLLAM

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

The **Quality Control (QC) Officer** is responsible for ensuring that all raw materials, in-process goods, and finished products meet statutory food safety standards, internal quality specifications, and hygiene guidelines. This role involves performing routine physical, chemical, and microbiological testing, monitoring hygiene and sanitation on the production line, maintaining regulatory documentation, and preventing standard deviations during processing.

Key Responsibilities1. Quality Inspection & Testing

* **Raw Material & Packaging Testing:** Inspect incoming raw materials, ingredients, and packaging materials to verify compliance with quality specifications before accepting deliveries.
* **In-Process Quality Monitoring:** Conduct routine checks on production lines (e.g., temperature control, weight checks, seal integrity, moisture levels, pH, viscosity, and sensory evaluation).
* **Finished Product Testing:** Sample and test finished goods prior to release, verifying compliance with regulatory guidelines and customer requirements.
* **Laboratory Operations:** Perform standard chemical analysis (acid value, moisture content, peroxide value, brix, etc.) and collect samples for internal/external microbiological testing.

2. Hygiene, Sanitation & Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)

* Audit production areas, equipment, and personnel for compliance with **GMP**, **GHP (Good Hygiene Practices)**, and company sanitation SOPs.
* Monitor sanitation cycles (CIP/COP processes) and swab testing of equipment and food-contact surfaces.
* Oversee pest control activities and coordinate with external pest control service providers.

3. Compliance & Standards Management

* Maintain and monitor food safety systems, including **HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point)**, **ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000**, and local regulatory codes (e.g., FSSAI, FDA, EFSA).
* Monitor **Critical Control Points (CCPs)** and **Operational Prerequisite Programs (OPRPs)** on the shop floor.
* Log all non-conformances, initiate corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans, and isolate non-conforming products.

4. Documentation & Record Keeping

* Maintain comprehensive records of daily test reports, certificate of analysis (COA), equipment calibration logs, and line inspection sheets.
* Assist in internal and third-party food safety audits.

Qualifications & SkillsEducational Background

* **Bachelor’s Degree** in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field.

Work Experience

* **1 to 4 years** of hands-on Quality Control / Quality Assurance experience within a food manufacturing, processing, or packaging plant.

Technical & Soft Skills

* Solid understanding of food safety standards (**HACCP, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, GMP**).
* Hands-on experience with laboratory testing equipment (pH meters, refractometers, titrators, analytical balances, etc.).
* Familiarity with local and international food regulations.
* High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
* Effective communication skills to coordinate with production, procurement, and warehouse teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Reduction in Line Non-Conformances & Product Defect Rates**
* **100% Adherence to CCP & Hygiene Audits**
* **Zero Regulatory Audit Deviations**
* **Timely Release of Finished Goods Batches**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Right Store Framework End to End**

Steward the 7 steps of Right Store (Assessment through Execute/Measure) across the full business cycle. Define the global framework by Route To Market and Channel so markets operate from a single, scalable methodology. **4. Standards, KPIs and Capability**

**Knowledge:**

* Execution KPI structures, comparability standards and cadences across regions and markets

* Field coaching standards and capability-building approaches across multiple markets

**Success Metrics:**

* 6STAC coaching standard embedded in field routines across regions

**Execution KPI Dictionary**

* Coverage, frequency and productivity per visit tracked and improving

**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels

The ideal candidate should possess in-depth knowledge of microbial biotechnology, microbiology, fermentation technology, product development and industrial-scale biological manufacturing.

The candidate will be responsible for independently managing the R&D department, leading the research team, driving innovation, developing commercially viable products and taking complete ownership of R&D operations and deliverables.

* Optimize microbial growth, yield, productivity and process efficiency.

* Oversee downstream processing, formulation and product stability.

**4. Technical Excellence & Innovation**

* Develop new technologies and improve existing products and processes.
* Establish research protocols, validation procedures and technical standards.
* Evaluate new scientific developments and implement relevant technologies.
* Establish research collaborations with universities, institutions and external technical experts.

* Work closely with Production, Quality Control, Regulatory and Marketing teams.

* Ensure effective technology transfer from R&D to manufacturing.

* 10–15 years of relevant experience in R&D within biotechnology, industrial microbiology, microbial products or fermentation-based industries.
* Proven experience in independently leading an R&D department or managing a substantial R&D team.
* Strong hands-on experience in microbial product development and industrial fermentation.
* Demonstrated experience in laboratory-to-industrial-scale technology transfer and product commercialization.
* Experience in Agriculture, Aquaculture, Poultry, Probiotics or Industrial Enzyme sectors will be preferred.

Essential Leadership Competencies

* Strong technical and scientific knowledge.
* Independent decision-making and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent team leadership and people-management skills.
* Strategic research planning and execution.
* Ability to take complete departmental ownership.
* Strong communication and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Result-oriented approach with commercial and business awareness.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

**Venture Builder (General Manager)**

  

Abu Dhabi, UAE (On-site) | Full-time | Reporting to the Owner

Take full ownership of an established healthy café and grab-and-go brand in Abu Dhabi and build it into a profitable, scalable business. You will run it as your own: first fix, then grow.
  
In the first phase you professionalise operations, restructure the menu and central kitchen workflows, and bring every outlet to strong unit economics. In the second you build what comes next: new revenue streams, a sharper concept and a model that is ready to multiply.
  
This is a role for a builder. You get a brand customers already know, a central kitchen, three locations, a team, and the freedom to decide.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Operational leadership

  

• Build and implement scalable SOPs across the outlets and the central kitchen.
  
• Introduce KPI-based performance management and weekly operating routines.
  
• Improve labour scheduling, cost-of-goods discipline, waste control and speed of service.
  
• Simplify and standardise workflows, menu and ingredient use.
  
Turnaround and unit economics
  
• Remove operational bottlenecks and improve unit economics at the existing outlets.
  
• Deliver profitability at outlet and company level within a defined timeframe.
  
• Optimise the central kitchen and put its spare capacity to work.
  
P&L ownership

jobs.title: Project Lead
jobs.description:
**Project Lead - Jomara International, Dubai, UAE**

Reports to: Director - Jomara International

**Job Purpose:**

The Project Lead runs JOMARA's new product development (NPD) and commercial execution projects from first idea to delivery on shelf. You will own the plan for every new product, new and seasonal packaging, supermarket planograms and trade show participation. You will coordinate internal teams, suppliers and retail partners so every launch lands on time, on budget and to JOMARA's premium standard.

**Key Accountabilities:**

New Product Development (NPD)

* Lead NPD projects end-to-end: concept, product brief, development and sampling, costing, approvals, production trial and launch.
* Run a stage-gate process with clear milestones, owners and sign-offs at each step.
* Coordinate Production, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales and Finance throughout each project.
* Make sure every product meets labelling, shelf-life, certification (organic, halal, food safety) and market import requirements.
* Track performance after launch and feed lessons into the next project.
* Forecasting and planning along with the supply chain

**Packaging Development (new and seasonal)**

* Manage new packaging and redesign projects from brief to delivered stock: agency briefing, artwork, proofs, approvals, printing and supplier lead times.
* Plan and deliver seasonal and gifting packaging (Ramadan, Eid, Hajj & Umrah, National Day, year-end and international festive seasons) on a calendar that works back from in-store dates.
* Manage packaging suppliers, minimum order quantities, costs and quality checks.
* Check artwork accuracy for each market: languages, regulatory text and barcodes.

**Planogram and In-store Execution**

* Manage Jomara planograms for supermarket partners: prepare proposals, agree them with category managers and track implementation.
* Build new listings and range changes into planograms together with Sales and merchandising teams.
* Run store checks on planogram compliance, share of shelf, pricing and visibility; report gaps and corrective actions.
* Support seasonal displays and secondary placements in store.

**Trade Show**

* Own the trade show calendar and budget (e.g. Gulfood, SIAL, Anuga and other target-market shows)
* Manage the full trade show checklist: registration, stand design and build, samples and shipments, marketing materials, logistics, travel and visas, staffing, lead capture and post-show follow-up.
* Report leads and return on investment after each show.

**Project Delivery Management and Coordination**

* Keep one project tracker covering all projects: timelines, owners, budget, risks and status.
* Run regular project meetings and prepare status updates for the Director – JOMARA International.
* Flag risks and delays early, agree fixes and escalate when needed.
* Build standard templates and checklists (NPD stage-gate, packaging critical path, trade show checklist) so delivery is repeatable.

**Key Performance Indicator**

* NPD and packaging projects delivered on time, within budget and to specification.
* Seasonal packaging in stores by the agreed date for every season.
* Planogram compliance and share of shelf in key supermarket accounts.
* Trade show checklists completed on time; leads generated and converted.
* Sales from new products versus plan.
* Stakeholder feedback on coordination and follow-through.

**Experience requirement:**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain or a related field.
* 3–5 years' experience, with at least 2 years leading cross-functional projects or programmes.
* Background in FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods.
* Hands-on experience launching products, customers or markets (export or international expansion preferred).
* Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort with project management tools.
* Fluent English.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the GCC (UAE and KSA) retail and e-commerce.
* Exposure to food export compliance (labelling, certifications, import rules) worldwide.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Structured and organised:**
  turns big goals into clear, workable plans.
* **Commercially minded:**
  understands how projects drive sales, margin and brand growth.
* **Influence without authority:**
  gets results through people across functions and partners.
* **Clear communicator:**
  writes and presents simply, for both working teams and senior leaders.
* **Analytical:**
  comfortable with numbers, budgets and trade-offs.
* **Proactive and resilient:**
  raises problems early and keeps moving in a fast-growing business.
* **Ownership:**
  follows through until the job is done.

jobs.title: Manager Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Us**
talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real-time tracking and payments.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
  
  
We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat

**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days**
: You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
  
  
**By 6 months**
: Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
  
  
**By 12 months**
: You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**You must have**

* 6+ years of hands-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross-platform)
* 2+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade-offs between native vs cross-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data

**Bonus If You Have**

* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or event-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams

**This role is for you if...**

* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought

**This role is NOT for you if...**

* You want a pure people-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices

**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
  
  
**Engineering Manager**
— You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Manager**
— You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
  
  
**Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company-wide technical strategy, build director-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …
  
  

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. * Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.
* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.
* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.
* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.
* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.
