jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
  
  
We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
  
  
Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****
**What Did We Order?**
****Technical Experience****

* Deep expertise in machine learning, generative AI, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems, and data mining.
* Hands-on knowledge of ML and GenAI frameworks: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers, and LLM fine-tuning.
* Proficiency with the OpenAI SDK and familiarity with major LLM provider APIs for building and orchestrating production AI systems.
* Hands-on experience with LangGraph for building stateful, multi-step agentic workflows and complex agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with Hugging Face (Transformers, Hub, Inference API) for model sourcing, fine-tuning, and deployment.
* Solid understanding of embeddings, dense and sparse retrieval, vector databases, and semantic search, for building RAG pipelines and similarity-based applications.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean production code, data structures and algorithms, ML system design.
* Proven experience shipping and monitoring ML models in production, with a solid grasp of MLOps practices.
* Strong data and ML engineering skills: building and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow) and robust feature engineering.
* Excellent SQL and Python; solid statistical foundations including experiment design, causal inference, and predictive methods.
* Familiarity with agentic system design (harness-first thinking, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, and production feedback loops) is a strong plus.
* Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. A postgraduate degree is a plus.
* 6+ years of experience in data science, ML engineering, and/or generative AI, including shipping models to production.
* 2+ years managing or leading a data science or ML team, with a track record of developing talent and delivering through others.
* Experience building ML systems in an online consumer product environment is a strong plus.

****Additional Information****
Mindset & Ways of Working
  
  

* Curiosity over certainty: you're excited to try the new model or framework this week.
* Ownership: you treat cost, latency, and business impact as your problem, and your team's.
* Bias to build: a prototype in a real workflow beats a perfect design doc every time.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: most of what we build has no playbook yet, and you help write it.
* Keep it simple: pick the approach that delivers the most value with the least complexity, and #makeithappen.

**At talabat, your success is defined by both results and behaviors. We hire for excellence in craft and for the Leadership Principles that shape how we think, decide, and collaborate. What you achieve matters, and how you achieve it defines us. Together, they move the business forward and deliver great experiences. Learn more about our Leadership Principles here.**

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development
jobs.description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.

If you are passionate about culinary excellence, logistics, and delivering world-class service, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.

As a **Manager Culinary Development,** you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.

Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.

**In this role, you will be:**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.
* Accountable for the product development life cycle management of EK owned, category specific, food and beverage items.
* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.
* Responsible for identifying and developing food and beverage promotional and celebratory initiatives to effectively promote and market EKs award winning offering.
* Responsible for carrying out regular industry benchmarking across all hospitality sectors to ensure that EK remains at the forefront of food and beverage innovation.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**

**Qualification:**

* An attested degree (12+3) or equivalent work experience.
* Culinary apprenticeship is preferred.

**Experience:**

* + 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.
  + Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation and standardisation of menus and recipes featuring **North and South American cuisines** , with in-depth knowledge of regional culinary traditions, authentic cooking techniques, emerging food trends, ingredient selection, nutritional principles, portion control and cost optimisation, ensuring culinary authenticity, consistency and alignment with diverse passenger preferences.
* **And/or**

  + Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation, standardisation and management of **Special Meals (SPMLs),** including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals, supported by sound knowledge of nutrition, dietary principles, menu engineering, allergen management and religious and cultural food requirements, ensuring nutritional suitability, recipe consistency and alignment with diverse passenger needs.

**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Comprehensive knowledge of and passion for, global cuisines, emerging culinary trends, and evolving guest preferences.

* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.
* Strong understanding of airline catering operations, including large-scale production, cook-chill processes, and the associated operational challenges and considerations.

* Proven ability to train, coach and educate colleagues and external catering partners on recipe execution and individual dish preparation.

* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised with strong planning, prioritisation, and project management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities within tight timeframes.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!

##### **Salary & benefits**

Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. That's in addition to transport benefits, life insurance and much more.

Discover what it's like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city of Dubai and build a rewarding career with Emirates!

jobs.title: Manager, Nutrition, Health and Wellness
jobs.description:
POSITION VACANCY

Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness

POSITION SNAPSHOT

Company: Nestlé

Location: Dubai - HQ

POSITION SUMMARY

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.

* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.

* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.

* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.

* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.

* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.

* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)

* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.

* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.

* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.

* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.

* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.

* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.

* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.

* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

**Why Research and Development?**
---------------------------------

We are on a journey to A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World. A world where smokers who would otherwise continue to smoke, have migrated to smokeless alternatives. This is why we are always innovating, experimenting, and delivering new solutions. This is why our R&D and Science department is so important to the business, and we are investing and accelerating our activities to generate new science and innovation. Today, we operate in a broad spectrum of scientific fields including molecular biology, toxicology, and chemistry, and it is that breadth of expertise which fuels the relentless innovation and learning that sets us apart as an industry leader.

**Why BAT?**
------------

At BAT, we’re committed to more than just jobs, we’re dedicated to purposeful careers - It's one of the many reasons we have been named as a Global Top Employer for the eighth consecutive year.
  
  
We believe that Leadership shouldn’t be confined to titles. It’s a mindset and through our leading Learning and Development programmes, you’ll continuously develop your skills and experience. With our unwavering support, you’ll work in cross functional teams connecting with industry leaders and expanding your professional network.
  
  
Join us at BAT, where purpose meets possibility, and your career story unfolds.

---------------------

Building a Smokeless World is no small feat—it’s fueled by the collective efforts of talented individuals, each bringing their unique perspective. This is the most innovative chapter in BAT’s history, and you can help shape it.

Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

**Scientific Engagement Manager**
---------------------------------

**BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.**  
**To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

**What are the key objectives and expectations from this role?**

The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.

This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.

They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.

**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**

This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

**Role duties and accountabilities**
------------------------------------

* Define and deliver geographically-focused collaborator segmentation/mapping and scientific engagement strategy
* Establishing and implementing a worldwide scientific regulatory engagement strategy that actively recognizes and addresses regulatory opportunities and challenges on critical scientific topics
* Lead senior-level scientific and regulatory interactions with APMEA West authorities. Translate scientific evidence into clear positions and craft engagement strategies for tobacco harm reduction, product regulation, and relevant FMCG and pharmaceutical regulatory frameworks.
* Preparing the essential scientific materials to enable CORA to collaborate with political and regulatory organizations on BAT and third-party science to implement evidence-based regulation across the Group
* Bringing to bear the Global Scientific Evidence and Advocacy teams to develop the necessary scientific inputs. These inputs support engagement with Health Care Professionals in the area to educate them on Nicotine & THR.
* Ensuring THR adoption initiatives promote steady Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance
* Leading and assisting APMEA West end markets in the creation of local scientific initiatives
* Improving networks of science-focused KOLs, covering private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. This involves overseeing pertinent regional forums to strengthen interactions among these groups. The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence. It also deals with scientific and technical regulatory topics.
* Assisting in the localisation of scientific advocacy in layperson terms for political and third-party collaborators, taking into consideration regional sensibilities and cultural aspects
* Ensuring that adequate technical engagement assistance on product standards development to end markets and directly to national standards authorities is provided
* Working with the Scientific Evidence Team to disseminate BAT Science in the region and acting as a spokesperson, where appropriate
* Upskilling end-markets on scientific literacy and identifying scientific fora and opportunities to bring BAT Science and other research to bear within end markets. This allows it to be coordinated into their campaign and regulatory engagement plans.

**Experience, skills, knowledge**
---------------------------------

-----------------------

* Knowledge and experience of BAT's New Category products, ingredients, and technologies

* Sound knowledge of tobacco, food, or pharmaceutical science complexities including chemistry, toxicology, pre-clinical, clinical, and behavioural science

jobs.title: Application Specialist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
**Interested in a career that matters?**
As an Application Specialist, you will help dairy and cheese customers across KSA and the Middle East successfully implement Novonesis solutions through hands-on technical expertise, industrial trials, and customer support. You will join a collaborative technical team supporting customers and application activities and work closely with both internal colleagues and external customers.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
This is a hands-on role focused primarily on execution and optimization. You will combine dairy application expertise with customer-facing technical support, helping customers implement cultures, enzymes, and application solutions while improving product quality, yield, texture, functionality, and process efficiency.
  
  
The position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and supports customers across KSA and other Middle East markets.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide technical customer support primarily for cheese and fermented dairy applications across KSA and other Middle East markets.
* Lead and execute industrial and pilot-scale trials at customer sites, supporting the successful implementation of solutions and documenting results through relevant reporting systems and customer reports.
* Support Local Application Center activities by designing and running application trials based on customer requirements, using appropriate formulations, methodologies, standards, and equipment.
* Work closely with customers to troubleshoot manufacturing challenges and optimize product quality, yield, texture, functionality, and process efficiency.
* Collaborate with the Head of Technical Dairy to design, execute, evaluate, and follow up on customer and internal trial protocols.
* Deliver technical presentations, workshops, and customer training, and support commercial teams with technical expertise during customer visits, project discussions, product evaluations, and business development activities.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Dairy Science, Food Science, Food Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in the dairy industry, preferably with strong exposure to cheese manufacturing and applications.
* Hands-on experience conducting industrial trials and providing technical customer support in dairy processing environments.
* Strong knowledge of cheese production technologies, cultures, enzymes, and dairy processing principles.
* Fluency in English.
* Strong communication, presentation, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, work independently, and collaborate effectively within a regional team.
* Ability to travel frequently across KSA and other Middle East countries, up to 50% of the time.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* Arabic language skills are a strong advantage.
* A customer-focused approach and ability to build effective relationships across diverse cultures.
* An interest in continuously developing expertise in cheese manufacturing processes, cultures, enzymes, and dairy ingredient applications relevant to the Middle East market.

**What We Offer You**
You will work in a collaborative technical environment where application expertise and close customer partnerships come together. The role provides opportunities to work across customer projects, application activities, and commercial collaboration while continuing to build your technical expertise in dairy and cheese applications.
  
  
**Working conditions**
The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a hybrid way of working. Frequent travel across KSA and other Middle East countries is required, up to 50% of the time.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs cosmetics ITALIAN SPEAKER
jobs.description:
Ti piacerebbe entrare a far parte della sede WYCON Cosmetics di Dubai e contribuire all'espansione internazionale di un brand beauty in forte crescita?

Se cerchi un'opportunità professionale a Dubai in un contesto dinamico, strutturato e internazionale, questa potrebbe essere l'occasione giusta per te.

**Chi siamo**

WYCON Cosmetics è un brand italiano di bellezza fondato nel 2009 da Gianfranco Satta e Raffaella Pagano, con l'obiettivo di rendere accessibile il make-up di alta qualità, combinando innovazione, performance e stile Made in Italy.

Oggi WYCON Cosmetics conta oltre 300 negozi nel mondo, con una presenza consolidata in mercati strategici in Europa, Asia, Medio Oriente e Nord Africa, sostenuta da un ambizioso piano di espansione internazionale.

**I nostri riconoscimenti 2026**

* Best Visual Experience
* Best Retailer Elite

**Il ruolo**

Il Dipartimento Prodotto di WYCON Cosmetics, presso la sede di Dubai (EAU), è alla ricerca di un/una Regulatory Affairs Specialist che supporti le attività di conformità normativa e accesso ai mercati, garantendo che i prodotti cosmetici rispettino tutti i requisiti locali e internazionali applicabili. La risorsa contribuirà attivamente ai processi di registrazione dei prodotti, alla gestione della documentazione tecnica e all'apertura di nuovi mercati, collaborando con team interfunzionali e interlocutori internazionali.

**Principali responsabilità**

Regulatory Affairs e conformità internazionale

* Garantire la conformità normativa dei prodotti cosmetici nei mercati internazionali.
* Supportare l'ingresso in nuovi mercati, analizzando i requisiti normativi e la documentazione necessaria.
* Monitorare e interpretare gli aggiornamenti normativi nazionali e internazionali relativi al settore cosmetico.
* Verificare la conformità di formule, claim, etichette e INCI alle normative locali.
* Gestire e validare le notifiche dei prodotti sui portali regolatori.
* Preparare, aggiornare e revisionare la documentazione tecnica e normativa, tra cui:

-Product Information File (PIF);

-Notifica sui principali portali;

-schede di sicurezza (SDS) e documentazione tecnica;

* Certificati di libera vendita (Certificate of Free Sale) e certificati di origine.
* Coordinare le richieste di documentazione per l'esportazione con distributori, partner e autorità locali.
* Supportare la revisione delle grafiche e la validazione dei packaging per i mercati internazionali.
* Collaborare con autorità regolatorie, laboratori, fornitori e consulenti esterni.

Supporto all'espansione nei mercati internazionali

* Analizzare i requisiti normativi per il lancio di prodotti cosmetici nei mercati esteri.
* Collaborare con i team Marketing, Ricerca e Sviluppo (R&D), Supply Chain e Grafica per garantire la conformità di prodotti e packaging.
* Supportare progetti di internazionalizzazione e adattamento dei prodotti alle specificità dei singoli mercati.

* Almeno 2–3 anni di esperienza in ambito Regulatory Affairs nel settore cosmetico internazionale.
* Solida conoscenza della normativa sui prodotti cosmetici.
* Familiarità con le normative dei seguenti paesi: Stati Uniti, America Latina, Africa, Asia, Medio Oriente.

* Precisione e attenzione ai dettagli nella gestione della documentazione normativa.
* Capacità di problem solving e attitudine a lavorare in contesti internazionali dinamici.

* L'opportunità di entrare in un'azienda internazionale in forte crescita.
* Esposizione a mercati globali e progetti di espansione internazionale.
* Opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale.
* Collaborazione con team interfunzionali e internazionali.
* Possibilità di contribuire direttamente al lancio globale di prodotti beauty innovativi.

**Dettagli dell'offerta**

* Retribuzione: commisurata all'esperienza e alla seniority.
* Contratto: full-time.
* Sede di lavoro: Dubai, in presenza.

**Job Description**
**About Analog Sports**
Analog Sports is a training app built around Ana, an AI coach you can just talk to. She builds your training plan, reads the data from everything you train with, and explains what it means for your next session. Analog sponsors professional cycling teams, and they train on the same platform.
  
  
**The role**
You make Ana a great coach. Ana’s coaching is built on your judgement: you turn how an expert coach decides into rules, numbers and tests that Ana follows, and you check that she gets it right. You won’t coach athletes one to one. Your athletes are everyone who trains with Ana.
  
  
We’re a flat organisation, and you report directly to the CEO.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define how Ana coaches: training load, form and fatigue, building toward an event, testing and recovery. You write each one as clear rules with thresholds and worked examples.
* Write up the coaching logic for the features you own: the problem, the rules, what good looks like, and how we’ll test it. Then work with design and engineering until it ships.
* Own the maths: every metric and calculation in the app is correct, explained in plain words, and reviewed regularly.
* Build the tests that tell us whether Ana coaches well: real athlete cases, the answers a good coach would give, and a score on every release.
* Review Ana’s work: plans, workout feedback and daily guidance. You find where she’s wrong and fix it with our product and AI engineers.
* Sign off the coaching side of every new feature, alongside product.
* Be the coaches’ voice in the product: how coaches work with their athletes in the app, from one athlete to a squad of 200.
* Work with the coaching staff of the professional teams we sponsor.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 10+ years as an expert coach in cycling, running or triathlon, with amateurs as well as elite athletes.
* Deep knowledge of training load and performance modelling: CTL, ATL and TSB, ramp rate, critical power and critical speed, power and pace zones, testing protocols, periodisation.
* Real experience working with AI. You’ve used AI assistants and models seriously in your work, not just tried them. You know what they do well, where they go wrong (confident answers that are wrong, following what’s written rather than what’s meant), and how to steer them. No coding needed.
* Clear writing. You can turn a judgement call into a rule someone else, or an AI, can follow, edge cases included.
* Comfort with data. You’d rather check a calculation against the raw file than trust the chart.

**Nice to have**

* Coaching swimming.
* Coaching strength and weightlifting for endurance athletes.
* An MSc or PhD in exercise physiology or sports science.
* Experience with a professional, continental or national team.
* Experience working on a training app or platform.

**By the end of your first three months**

* Ana’s coaching rules for load, form and testing are written down and in her hands.
* A coaching test set runs on every release.
* Dynamic training plans are working for running, swimming and weight training, alongside cycling.
* Every metric in the app has been checked and explained.
* You’ve written up the coaching logic for at least one new feature and seen it into the build.

Job Details
  
  
Role Level: Executive-Level Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Abu Dhabi Company Website: https://analog.io Job Function: Clinical & Lab Research Company Industry/
  
  
Sector: Sports And Recreation Technology Science And Research Software Data And Analytics

jobs.title: Subsidy & Incentives Expert — Agriculture Subsidy Redesign, Targeting, and Impact

jobs.description:
Agriculture Subsidy Redesign, Targeting, and Impact

**Role purpose**

Design and implement subsidies and incentive mechanisms that improve productivity, sustainability, and farmer livelihoods while ensuring
**fiscal sustainability, compliance, and measurable impact**
. This role is a technical lead within the TMO portfolio and owns the end-to-end subsidy reform workstream.

**Responsibilities:**

**Diagnosis and design**

* Map existing subsidy landscape: eligibility, spend, leakage risks,incentive distortions, overlaps.
* Segment beneficiaries (farm types, size,crop/livestock systems, geography, vulnerability).
* Design alternative subsidy models:
* Targeted input subsidies (seed/feed/fertilizer) with controls
* Outcome/conditionality-linked incentives (water efficiency, compliance, productivity)
* Capital grants/ co-investment schemesfor modernization (irrigation, greenhouses, renewables)
* Develop fiscalscenarios and trade-offs for government decision-makers.

**Targeting, eligibility, and controls**

* Define eligibility rules, verification methods,and audit trails(registry integration, land/farm ID, production evidence).
* Design leakageprevention controls (claimsvalidation, supplier vetting,anomaly detection triggers).
* Develop compliance mechanisms and enforcement pathways aligned with regulations.
* Develop cost-benefit scenarios to define and review on an ongoing basis applicability of the subsidies.

**Implementation of architecture**

* Translate designinto executable implementation plan: policy drafts,operating procedures, system requirements, vendor/process changes.
* Work with digital/data teamson:
* Farmer registryintegration
* e-voucher / digital disbursement logic
* Case management workflows for exceptions and appeals
* Support procurement packages (system integrators, payment rails, verification services).

**Monitoring and impactevaluation framework**

* Define an impact evaluation approach:
* Logic models(inputs → outputs→ outcomes)
* Baselines and measurement methods(surveys, remote sensingproxies, administrative data)
* Quasi-experimental designoptions were feasible(phased rollout, comparison groups)
* Establish a benefits trackingdiscipline within the TMO (impactreporting cadence, auditability).

**Stakeholder management**

* Coordinate with finance/treasury, audit,regulators, farmer associations, suppliers, and service providers.
* Develop communication materials to supportadoption and managepolitical economic risks.

**Required experience and qualifications.**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in economics, public policy, agricultural economics, or related.Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years in agricultural subsidy/incentives, social supporttargeting, agri-policy implementation, or development programs at leading organization.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing targeting and payment/disbursement mechanisms (public sector preferred).
* Strong quantitative capability: fiscal modeling,program evaluation methods.
* Familiarity with global best practices (FAO, World Bank, IFAD style program disciplines) preferred.

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert

* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building

* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience

Education

jobs.title: Branch Accountant | Al-Futtaim Automotive| Dubai
jobs.description:
About Al-Futtaim

  

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  

**Overview of the role**

  

We are currently hiring a detail-oriented **Branch Accountant** to support the day-to-day finance operations of a busy automotive branch in the UAE.

  

In this role, you will help ensure that financial transactions are accurate, properly documented, reconciled and processed on time. You will provide operational finance support across sales, aftersales, parts and administration, covering customer collections, vendor payments, banking, petty cash, vehicle deal documentation and month-end closing activities.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Review daily branch transactions, including invoices, receipts, customer collections, vendor payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* Check vehicle deal documentation, pricing requests and discount approvals for accuracy and completeness.
* Monitor cash collections, card receipts, bank deposits, petty cash and other banking activities.
* Prepare reconciliations for customer accounts, vendor balances, deposits, advances, clearing accounts and petty cash.
* Investigate outstanding balances, transaction errors and reconciling items, escalating unresolved issues when required.
* Support month-end closing activities, including accruals, provisions, reclassifications, journals and expense reviews.
* Track operating expenses, purchase orders, supplier invoices and cost-centre postings.
* Identify missing approvals, documentation gaps, unusual financial movements and control exceptions.
* Maintain accurate schedules, trackers and supporting documentation for reporting and audit purposes.
* Ensure branch finance activities comply with applicable financial policies, approval requirements and internal controls.
* Coordinate with branch operations, shared services, treasury, credit control and other finance stakeholders.

**Required skills to be successful**

  

* Good understanding of accounting principles and day-to-day financial transactions.
* Strong reconciliation skills and numerical accuracy.
* Knowledge of receivables, payables, banking, petty cash, accruals and financial controls.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to maintain accurate trackers and schedules.
* Working knowledge of SAP or a similar ERP system.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
* Ability to identify transaction errors, missing approvals and outstanding reconciling items.
* Good communication and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage daily priorities and meet month-end deadlines.
* A reliable, accountable and process-focused approach to work.

**About the team**

  

You will join a collaborative automotive finance team supporting a high-volume branch environment. You will work closely with the Finance Manager, branch management, sales, service and parts teams, as well as shared services, treasury and credit control.

  

The team plays an important role in maintaining strong financial discipline while providing responsive support to daily branch operations.

  

**What equips you for the role**

  

* A degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related discipline.
* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in accounting, branch finance, retail finance, dealership finance or operational finance support.
* Experience preparing reconciliations and supporting month-end closing activities.
* Experience reviewing financial documentation and following up on outstanding items.
* Exposure to automotive, retail, trading or another high-volume transactional environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP system is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during month-end and peak transaction periods.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

  

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

  

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

  

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

  

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

  

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

jobs.description:
In line with the UAE Government’s strategy in empowering and developing nationals, Emirates NBD is committed to welcoming the young generation into an innovative, modern and supportive work environment to contribute to the nation's success. We are looking to find the best UAEN talent to join our ENBD family.

  

In **International Onboarding, CDD Remediation and Periodic Reviews**, you will support international banking by managing client onboarding, customer due diligence (CDD) remediation and periodic review activities. You will work closely with Relationship Managers, compliance and relevant stakeholders to ensure cases are completed on time in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and established governance standards. This role requires a detail-oriented and proactive approach. In **International Onboarding, CDD Remediation and Periodic Reviews**, you will support international banking by managing client onboarding, customer due diligence (CDD) remediation and periodic review activities. You will work closely with Relationship Managers, compliance and relevant stakeholders to ensure cases are completed on time in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and established governance standards. This role requires a detail-oriented and proactive approach.

  
  
Responsibilities:  

* **Client onboarding:** Support end-to-end onboarding for international corporate and individual clients. Review and validate client documentation, know your customer (KYC) information and CDD requirements, including complete source of wealth (SOW) and source of funds (SOF) write-ups.
* Coordinate with Relationship Managers and other stakeholders to obtain outstanding information and documentation. Identify gaps, escalate potential compliance or regulatory concerns, and process onboarding cases efficiently in line with applicable local regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* **CDD remediation:** Support remediation exercises to address outstanding KYC/CDD deficiencies. Review existing client files, identify gaps and coordinate the collection of missing or outdated documentation.
* Monitor and follow up on remediation cases to ensure timely closure. Maintain accurate remediation trackers, provide regular progress updates and escalate overdue, high-risk or sensitive cases to the appropriate management.
* **Periodic reviews:** Conduct and coordinate periodic KYC/CDD reviews for existing clients based on their assigned classifications. Review client profiles, ownership structures, business activities and supporting documents.
* Identify changes in customer risk profiles and ensure appropriate escalation or updates, supported by evidence where required. Review existing and new-to-bank (NTB) high-risk accounts for compliance with KYC/anti-money laundering (AML) standards and regulatory requirements for high-risk clients and politically exposed persons (PEPs).
* **International coordination and governance:** Act as a key coordination point between the UAE head office and international offices, ensuring activities comply with the applicable regulatory requirements of each jurisdiction.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails to support internal reviews, regulatory examinations and audit requirements.

  
Qualifications:  

* Experience in banking operations, KYC/CDD, client onboarding, remediation and periodic reviews.
* Good understanding of AML, KYC, CDD and customer risk assessment.
* Experience handling high-net-worth (HNW) individuals and corporate clients with complex ownership structures, such as trusts, foundations and offshore entities.

The Scientific Engagement Manager APMEA West serves as the primary lead and coordinator for scientific engagement efforts in the Middle East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South Caucasus regions to promote uniform Tobacco Harm Reduction literacy and acceptance.
  
  
This individual will lead a proactive, regional outreach approach and engagement plan that quickly grows science-focused Key Opinion Leader (KOL) networks in the area. These include private and public research agencies, academic groups, and institutions in priority markets. They will improve connections among these groups, including managing relevant regional forums. The main purpose of this network is to support suitable engagement with regulators on THR, evidence-based public policy development, and scientific or technical regulatory issues. They will also direct scientific engagement with APMEA West South Health Care Professionals to promote Nicotine and THR education within this important partner group.
  
  
The Scientific Engagement Manager (APMEA West) will offer mentorship and assistance to the East, North Africa, Central Asia, and South end markets. They will help develop local scientific initiatives and KOL engagement plans, including prioritizing activities for Global CORA. This role represents BAT as a scientific peer in the external scientific community and serves as the technical lead and coordinator for global scientific regulatory engagement within national and supranational regulatory processes in the APMEA West region. Responsibilities include participation in recurring global regulatory events, international treaty revisions, and ad hoc scientific consensus analyses.
  
  
**What is the direct impact of this role on the team or organisation?**
This position is vital for advancing Tobacco Harm Reduction acceptance with policy makers according to the CORA strategy and engaging the scientific community via KOLs and PHAs. It applies scientific evidence and advocacy materials to foster appropriate interaction with external scientists and regulators. The role helps develop evidence-based public policies and supports CORA on scientific and regulatory issues. It acts as BAT’s technical authority in relevant scientific regulatory activities. The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

The network primarily supports engagement with regulators on tobacco harm reduction and the development of sound public policy based on evidence.
